Comprehensive Codebase Analysis - Core-Sync Repository

Based on my thorough exploration of the /Users/bangnb/Dev/DotNetWorkspaces/core-sync repository, here's everything you need to know for creating a CLAUDE.md file:

1. BUILD/TEST/LINT COMMANDS

Build & Deployment:

  • Build: dotnet build or dotnet publish -c Release -o /app/publish
  • Run: dotnet run (uses MatthewsLiquor profile)
  • Docker Build: The project includes a multi-stage Dockerfile
    • Stage 1: Builds with SDK 3.1
    • Stage 2: Runs with ASP.NET 3.1 runtime
    • Port: 5000/5001 (HTTPS on 5001, HTTP on 5000)

Database Tools:

  • Entity Framework: Uses dotnet-ef (v6.0.1 via .config/dotnet-tools.json)
  • Dapper: Version 2.0.123 (for SQL queries)
  • DB Scaffolding: dotnet ef dbcontext Scaffold (configured for code-first approach)

Testing:

  • No formal test framework detected (no xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest projects found)

Linting/Code Analysis:

  • No Roslyn analyzers or linting tools explicitly configured
  • WarningsAsErrors configured for: CS0414 (unused fields)

2. PROJECT STRUCTURE & ARCHITECTURE

Technology Stack:

  • Framework: .NET Core 3.1 (net3.1 SDK v3.1.426)
  • Language: C#
  • Architecture: ASP.NET Core MVC with Areas pattern
  • Web API: REST API with Swagger documentation (Swashbuckle v6.1.2)
  • ORM: Entity Framework Core 3.1.0 + Dapper
  • DI Container: Autofac 7.1.0

High-Level Architecture:

  • Multi-Area Design: Modular architecture with separate areas for different integrations
  • Repository Pattern: Service-based repositories for data access
  • Database-First Integration: Syncs data across multiple external systems

Project Layout:

MatthewsLiquor/
├── Areas/                          # 12 major integration modules
│   ├── Api/                        # API endpoints
│   ├── Bepos/                      # Bepos system sync (Controllers, Models, Repositories)
│   ├── BI/                         # Business Intelligence integration
│   ├── Cronjob/                    # Scheduled jobs
│   ├── Dtos/                       # Data Transfer Objects
│   │   ├── EF/                     # Entity Framework models (71+ entity classes)
│   │   ├── Bepos/
│   │   └── BI/
│   ├── Epoints/                    # Epoints system sync
│   ├── HangFire/                   # Background job scheduling
│   ├── Mangento/                   # Magento integration
│   ├── OSF/                        # Open Shop Front integration
│   ├── WebHook/                    # Webhook handling
│   └── (Warehouse & other modules)
├── Controllers/                    # Root controllers (HomeController)
├── Services/                       # Shared services (AppSettings)
├── Network/                        # HTTP client wrappers (BaseClient)
├── Helper/                         # Utility functions
├── Views/                          # Razor views (minimal)
├── Properties/                     # Launch settings
├── Resources/                      # Static resources
├── Program.cs                      # Entry point
├── Startup.cs                      # Configuration & DI setup
├── appsettings.json               # Configuration (connection strings, API keys, etc.)
├── global.json                     # SDK version (3.1.426)
├── nlog.config                     # NLog configuration
├── log4net.config                  # Log4Net configuration
├── Dockerfile                      # Multi-stage Docker build
└── MatthewsLiquor.csproj          # Project file

Key Areas Details:

Area Purpose Key Entities
OSF Open Shop Front integration Customer, Product, Sale, Register, Outlet, User, Inventory
Epoints E-Points loyalty system sync Customer, Product, Category, Branch, Supplier
Bepos BEPOS POS system Product, Customer, Transaction, Promotion, Inventory
BI Business Intelligence warehouse Product, Customer, Sale data replication
Magento Magento e-commerce sync Product, Category, Customer, Price List
WebHook Event handling WebHook listener and retry logic
Cronjob Scheduled background tasks Cron job management
HangFire Job scheduling framework (currently disabled in code)

Database Structure:

  • Primary DB: matthewsliquor (MS SQL Server 207.148.80.25)
  • BI DB: matthewsliquor_bi
  • Bepos DB: MATTHEWS_LIQUOR (separate instance)
  • Job DB: matthewsliquor_job_dev_local

Main Entity Types (71+ total):

  • Products, Categories, Brands, Families
  • Customers, Customer Groups, Customer Debt/Points
  • Sales Orders, Payments, Promotions
  • Suppliers, Inventory Transfers
  • Users, Roles, Permissions
  • Outlets, Registers, Sites
  • Warehouse Products, Barcodes

3. KEY CONFIGURATION FILES

Core Configuration:

  • appsettings.json - Connection strings & API credentials

    • DefaultConnection: Main database
    • BIConnection: Business Intelligence database
    • BeposConnection: BEPOS database
    • MSSQLWaterBillingJobs: Job database

  • Configuration Values:

    • Google API Key, Auth credentials
    • Epoints URL & Token
    • BEPOS URL, MAC, Operator ID
    • Sync intervals (Epoints: 20s, Bepos: 10s)
    • Default customer groups (Wholesale: 1, Retail: 3)

Logging:

  • nlog.config - Primary logging (files to Logs/ directory)
    • All logs: nlog-all-${shortdate}.log
    • Own logs: nlog-own-${shortdate}.log
    • Trace level for detailed debugging
    • Log4Net also configured in Program.cs

Dependency Injection (Startup.cs):

  • 29+ service registrations
  • Multiple DbContext configurations
  • Repository pattern implementations
  • Swagger documentation

Docker:

  • Multi-stage build (SDK 3.1 → ASP.NET 3.1 runtime)
  • Exposes port 5000
  • Entrypoint: dotnet MatthewsLiquor.dll

4. EXISTING DOCUMENTATION

Documentation Found:

  • README.md (at root) - Contains:
    • Entity Framework scaffolding commands with credentials
    • Cronjob URLs for token refresh and syncing operations
    • List of admin endpoints for various sync operations
    • Database connection examples

SQL Scripts:

  • scrips/inventory_transfer.sql - Database schema/procedures

Configuration Sample:

  • appsettings.json-sample - Template for configuration

5. AI ASSISTANT RULES

No existing AI assistant rules found:

  • No .cursorrules file
  • No .github/copilot-instructions.md
  • No .cursor/rules/ directory
  • No .vscode/settings.json with AI configuration

6. FRAMEWORK & LANGUAGE

Primary Stack:

  • Language: C# (.NET Core 3.1)
  • Framework: ASP.NET Core 3.1.0
  • ORM: Entity Framework Core 3.1.0
  • Hosting: Docker-compatible (self-contained deployment)

Key Dependencies:

  • Autofac 7.1.0 - Dependency injection
  • Dapper 2.0.123 - Micro ORM
  • GraphQL.Client 2.1.0 - GraphQL integration
  • Hangfire 1.7.28 - Background jobs (configured but disabled)
  • RestSharp 106.11.7 - HTTP client
  • Newtonsoft.Json 12.0.3 - JSON serialization
  • Swashbuckle.AspNetCore 6.1.2 - Swagger/OpenAPI docs
  • Serilog & NLog - Logging frameworks
  • Sentry 3.1.0 - Error tracking
  • PortaCapena.OdooJsonRpcClient 1.0.10 - Odoo integration
  • **Microsoft.Extensions.*** - Configuration, logging, DI

7. ENTRY POINTS & MAIN COMPONENTS

Application Entry Points:

  1. Program.cs (/Users/bangnb/Dev/DotNetWorkspaces/core-sync/MatthewsLiquor/Program.cs)

    • Creates host using CreateHostBuilder
    • Registers Log4Net logging
    • Initializes scope services
    • Runs the host

  2. Startup.cs (/Users/bangnb/Dev/DotNetWorkspaces/core-sync/MatthewsLiquor/Startup.cs)

    • Configures all services (DI container)
    • Sets up DbContext for 3 databases
    • Registers 29+ service implementations
    • Configures middleware pipeline
    • Enables Swagger documentation

  3. Route Mapping:

    • Areas route: {area:exists}/{controller}/{action}/{id?}
    • Default route: {controller}/{action}/{id?}
    • Home controller serves UI at root

Main Controllers:

Controller Route Purpose
HomeController / UI entry point
WebHookController /webhook Event ingestion & retry
EpointsXxxController /epoints/ Epoints system APIs
BeposXxxController /bepos/ BEPOS integration APIs
CronjobController /cronjob/ Task scheduling
Others (Api, BI, Magento) Various System-specific endpoints

Web API Endpoints:

  • Listed in README.md (refresh-token, sync-coupon, create-customer, etc.)
  • Swagger UI available at /swagger

Key Services:

  1. BaseClient (Network/BaseClient.cs) - HTTP client wrapper for external APIs
  2. AppSettings (Services/AppSettings.cs) - Configuration holder
  3. Repository Implementations - Data access for each domain
  4. WebHookRepositories - Webhook processing and retry logic
  5. Sync Repositories - Multi-system synchronization (OSF, Epoints, Bepos, BI, Magento)

Database Contexts:

  1. MatthewsLiquorDBContext - Main application database
  2. BeposDBContext - BEPOS database
  3. BIDBContext - Business Intelligence database

GIT INFORMATION

Current Branch: dev/webhook-customer-paid
Main Branch: master
Remote: http://gitlab.e-point.xyz:9898/matthews/core-sync.git

Recent Commits (by purpose):

Active Branches:

ADDITIONAL NOTES

  1. Build Artifacts: The codebase has generated bin/ and obj/ directories (already ignored in .gitignore)

  2. Logging: Dual logging system configured (NLog + Log4Net) with output to logs/ directory

  3. SQL Server Specific: Project uses Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer (3.1.0)

  4. Multi-Tenant/Multi-System: Designed to synchronize data across 5+ external systems

  5. Credentials in Config: appsettings.json contains database credentials and API tokens (should be using environment variables in production)

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using System.IO;
using Autofac;
using Microsoft.OpenApi.Models;
using SyncData.Services;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.EF;
using Hangfire;
using SyncData.Areas.Sync.Repositories.OSF.SyncProduct;
using SyncData.Areas.Mangento.Repositories;
using SyncData.Network;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.HangFire;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Cronjob.Repositories;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Dtos.EF;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncSale;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.WebHook.Repositories;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncCustomer;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncCustomer;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Mangento.Repositories.SyncCustomer;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncSale;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncProduct;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncPromotion;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncPromotion;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncRegister;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncSite;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncOutlet;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncUser;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncPaymentMethod;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncBranch;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncCategory.SyncParentCategory;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncCategory;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Bepos.Repositories.SyncBeposProduct;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Bepos.Repositories.SyncBeposCustomer;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Bepos.Repositories.SyncBeposTransaction;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Bepos.Repositories.SyncBeposPromotion;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.BI.Repositories.SyncBIProduct;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.BI.Repositories.SyncBICustomer;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.BI.Repositories.SyncBISale;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Bepos.Repositories.SyncBeposSupplier;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncSupplier;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncInventory;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Bepos.Repositories.SyncBepozInventory;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncInventory;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncOrder;

namespace MatthewsLiquor
{
    public class Startup
    {
        public static String EnvPath;
        public static IHostBuilder CreateHostBuilder(string[] args) =>
    Host.CreateDefaultBuilder(args)
        .ConfigureWebHostDefaults(webBuilder =>
        {
            // Add the following line:
            webBuilder.UseSentry("https://37f612505fc0425dbf5d678bb7625a2a@o390080.ingest.sentry.io/5230889");
        });

        /// Stores app settings.
        public IConfiguration Configuration { get; }
        public ILifetimeScope AutofacContainer { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>
        /// Injects app settings from a JSON file.
        /// </summary>
        public Startup(IWebHostEnvironment env)
        {
            EnvPath = env.ContentRootPath;
            var builder = new ConfigurationBuilder()
                .SetBasePath(env.ContentRootPath)
                .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json", optional: false, reloadOnChange: true)
                .AddJsonFile($"appsettings.{env.EnvironmentName}.json", optional: true)
                .AddEnvironmentVariables();
            Configuration = builder.Build();
        }

        public void ConfigureServices(IServiceCollection services)
        {
            //services.AddControllersWithViews().AddNewtonsoftJson();
            #region API
            services.AddRouting(options => options.LowercaseUrls = true);
            services.AddMvc()
                //.AddNewtonsoftJson(options =>
                //{
                //    options.SerializerSettings.ContractResolver = new DefaultContractResolver();
                //})
                .AddJsonOptions(
                options =>
                {
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.PropertyNamingPolicy = null;
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.WriteIndented = true;
                    //options.JsonSerializerOptions.PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true;
                });
            #endregion
            services.Configure<AppSettings>(Configuration.GetSection("AppSettings"));
            services.AddTransient<IDapper, Dapperr>();
            services.AddTransient<IBaseClient, BaseClient>();
            CoreConfigServices(services);
            services.AddOptions();
            BeposConfigServices(services);
            BIConfigServices(services);
            SwaggerConfig(services);
            

            // Add MVC.
            services.AddMvc();

            // Configure session.
            services.AddMemoryCache();
            services.AddDistributedMemoryCache();
            services.AddSession(options => {
                options.IdleTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10);
                options.Cookie =  new CookieBuilder() { Name = ".AuthCodeFlowTutorial.Session" };
            });
        }

        public void SwaggerConfig(IServiceCollection services)
        {
            services.AddSwaggerGen(options =>
            {
                options.SwaggerDoc("v1", new OpenApiInfo { Title = "Ez4shop API Document", Version = "v1" });
                options.AddSecurityDefinition("bearerAuth", new OpenApiSecurityScheme
                {
                    Description = "JWT containing userid claim",
                    Name = "Authorization",
                    In = ParameterLocation.Header,
                    Type = SecuritySchemeType.Http,
                    Scheme = "bearer",
                    BearerFormat = "JWT"
                });
            });
        }

        public void CoreConfigServices(IServiceCollection services)
        {

            services.AddDbContext<MatthewsLiquorDBContext>(options => {
                options.UseSqlServer(Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection"));
            }, ServiceLifetime.Transient);

            services.AddTransient<ISyncOSFProductRepositories, SyncOSFProductRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<IMagentoRepositories, MagentoRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ICronjobRepositories, CronjobRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncOSFSaleRepositories, SyncOSFSaleRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<IWebHookRepositories, WebHookRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncOSFCustomerRepositories, SyncOSFCustomerRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncEpointsCustomerRepositores, SyncEpointsCustomerRepositores>();
            services.AddTransient<IMangetoCustomerRepositories, MangetoCustomerRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories, SyncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncEpointsProductRepositories, SyncEpointsProductRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncPromotionRepositories, SyncPromotionRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncEpointsPromotionRepositories, SyncEpointsPromotionRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncRegisterRepositories, SyncRegisterRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncSiteRepositories, SyncSiteRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncOutletRepositories, SyncOutletRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncUserRepositories, SyncUserRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncPaymentMethodRepositories, SyncPaymentMethodRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncEpointsBranchRepositories, SyncEpointsBranchRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncEpointsBranchRepositories, SyncEpointsBranchRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncEpointsParentCategoryRepositories, SyncEpointsParentCategoryRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncEpointsCategoryRepositories, SyncEpointsCategoryRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncEpointsSupplierRepositories, SyncEpointsSupplierRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<HangFileCronJob, HangFileCronJob>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncInventoryRepositories, SyncInventoryRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncEpointsInventoryRepositories, SyncEpointsInventoryRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<ISyncOSFOrderRepositories, SyncOSFOrderRepositories>();
        }

        public void BeposConfigServices(IServiceCollection services)
        {
            services.AddDbContext<BeposDBContext>(options => {
                options.UseSqlServer(Configuration.GetConnectionString("BeposConnection"));
            }, ServiceLifetime.Transient);

            services.AddTransient<IBeposProductRepositories, BeposProductRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<IBeposCustomerRepositories, BeposCustomerRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<IBeposTransactionRepositories, BeposTransactionRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<IBeposPromotionRepositories, BeposPromotionRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<IBeposSupplierRepositories, BeposSupplierRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<IBeposInventoryRepositories, BeposInventoryRepositories>();
        }

        public void BIConfigServices(IServiceCollection services)
        {
            services.AddDbContext<BIDBContext>(options => {
                options.UseSqlServer(Configuration.GetConnectionString("BIConnection"));
            }, ServiceLifetime.Transient);

            services.AddTransient<IBIProductRepositories, BIProductRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<IBICustomerRepositories, BICustomerRepositories>();
            services.AddTransient<IBISaleRepositories, BISaleRepositories>();
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Configures the HTTP request pipeline.
        /// </summary>
        // This method gets called by the runtime. Use this method to configure the HTTP request pipeline.
        public void Configure(IApplicationBuilder app,
            IWebHostEnvironment env,
            ILoggerFactory loggerFactory)
        {

            var path = Directory.GetCurrentDirectory();
            loggerFactory.AddFile($"{path}\\Logs\\Log.txt");

            //this.AutofacContainer = app.ApplicationServices.GetAutofacRoot();

            app.UseDeveloperExceptionPage();
            // app.UseHangfireDashboard("/hangfire", new DashboardOptions
            // {
            //     IgnoreAntiforgeryToken = true,
            //     Authorization = new[] { new HangfireAuthFilter() }

            // });

            app.UseHttpsRedirection();
            app.UseSwagger();
            app.UseSwaggerUI(c =>
            {
                //c.RoutePrefix = "";
                c.SwaggerEndpoint("/swagger/v1/swagger.json", "Ez4shop API V1");
            });
            app.UseStaticFiles();
            app.UseSession();
            app.UseRouting();

            app.UseAuthorization();

            app.UseEndpoints(endpoints =>
            {
                
                endpoints.MapControllerRoute(
                    name: "MyArea",
                    pattern: "{area:exists}/{controller=Home}/{action=Index}/{id?}");
                endpoints.MapControllerRoute(
                    name: "default",
                    pattern: "{controller=Home}/{action=Index}/{id?}");
            });

        }
    }
}

# =========================
# Stage 1: Build
# =========================
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:3.1 AS build
WORKDIR /src

# Copy csproj và restore dependency
COPY *.sln .
COPY */*.csproj ./
RUN for file in $(ls *.csproj); do \
    mkdir -p project_tmp && mv $file project_tmp/ && cd project_tmp && \
    dotnet restore && cd .. && mv project_tmp/* ./ && rm -rf project_tmp; \
  done

# Copy toàn bộ source và build
COPY . .
RUN dotnet publish -c Release -o /app/publish

# =========================
# Stage 2: Runtime
# =========================
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:3.1
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /app/publish .

# Mở cổng (tùy ứng dụng của bạn)
EXPOSE 5000

# Lệnh khởi chạy
ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "MatthewsLiquor.dll"]

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.WebHook.Repositories;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;

using SyncData.Services;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

// For more information on enabling MVC for empty projects, visit https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=397860

namespace MatthewsLiquor.Areas.WebHook.Controllers
{
    [Area("webhook")]
    [Route("webhook")]
    public class WebHookController : Controller
    {
        private readonly ILogger<WebHookController> _logger;
        private readonly IOptions<AppSettings> _appSettings;
        private readonly IWebHookRepositories _webHookRepositories;
        public WebHookController(IOptions<AppSettings> appSettings, IWebHookRepositories webHookRepositories, ILogger<WebHookController> logger)
        {

            _appSettings = appSettings;
            _logger = logger;
            _webHookRepositories = webHookRepositories;
        }

        [HttpPost("/webhook")]
        public async Task<ActionResult> Webhook()
        {
           try
           {
               string body = "";
               using (StreamReader stream = new StreamReader(Request.Body))
               {
                   body = await stream.ReadToEndAsync();
               }
               _ = _webHookRepositories.InsertWebHook(body);
           }
           catch (Exception ex)
           {
               _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
           }
          
           return NoContent();
        }

        [HttpGet("/test")]
        public async Task<ActionResult> WebhookTest(int id)
        {
           try
           {
           
               _ =  await _webHookRepositories.InsertWebHookTest(id);
           }
           catch (Exception ex)
           {
               _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
           }

           return NoContent();
        }

        [HttpGet("/retry")]
        public ActionResult WebhookRetry(string eventType)
        {
           try
           {
           
                _webHookRepositories.RetryWebhook(eventType);
           }
           catch (Exception ex)
           {
               _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
           }

           return NoContent();
        }

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<nlog xmlns="http://www.nlog-project.org/schemas/NLog.xsd"
      xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
      autoReload="true"
      internalLogLevel="Debug"
      internalLogFile="${currentdir}/internal-nlog.txt">

  <!-- enable asp.net core layout renderers -->
  <extensions>
    <add assembly="NLog.Web.AspNetCore"/>
  </extensions>

  <!-- the targets to write to -->
  <targets>
    <!-- write logs to file  -->
    <target xsi:type="File" name="allfile" fileName="${currentdir}/nlog-all-${shortdate}.log"
            layout="${longdate}|${event-properties:item=EventId_Id}|${uppercase:${level}}|${logger}|${message} ${exception:format=tostring}" />

    <!-- another file log, only own logs. Uses some ASP.NET core renderers -->
    <target xsi:type="File" name="ownFile-web" fileName="${currentdir}/nlog-own-${shortdate}.log"
            layout="${longdate}|${event-properties:item=EventId_Id}|${uppercase:${level}}|${logger}|${message} ${exception:format=tostring}|url: ${aspnet-request-url}|action: ${aspnet-mvc-action}" />
  </targets>

  <!-- rules to map from logger name to target -->
  <rules>
    <!--All logs, including from Microsoft-->
    <logger name="*" minlevel="Trace" writeTo="allfile" />

    <!--Skip non-critical Microsoft logs and so log only own logs-->
    <logger name="Microsoft.*" maxlevel="Info" final="true" /> <!-- BlackHole without writeTo -->
    <logger name="*" minlevel="Trace" writeTo="ownFile-web" />
  </rules>
</nlog>

{
    public class MatthewsLiquorDBContext : DbContext
    {
        public MatthewsLiquorDBContext(DbContextOptions<MatthewsLiquorDBContext> options) : base(options)
        {
        }
        public MatthewsLiquorDBContext()
        {
        }
        protected override void OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
        {
            IConfigurationRoot configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
            .SetBasePath(Startup.EnvPath)
            .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json")
            .Build();
            optionsBuilder.UseSqlServer(configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection"));

        }
        protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
        {
            //modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new AppConfigConfiguration());
            modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new ProductInPriceListConfiguration());
            modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new ProductConfiguration());

            modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new WarehouseProductBarcodeConfiguration());
            modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new WarehouseProductInventoryConfiguration());
            modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new WarehouseProductPricesConfiguration());
            //base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder); 
            modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new BrandConfiguration());
            modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new FamilyConfiguration());
            modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new PriceListConfiguration());

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Build & Run Commands

```bash
# Build the project
dotnet build MatthewsLiquor/MatthewsLiquor.csproj

# Run the application
dotnet run --project MatthewsLiquor/MatthewsLiquor.csproj

# Publish for deployment
dotnet publish MatthewsLiquor/MatthewsLiquor.csproj -c Release -o /app/publish

# Docker build
docker build -t core-sync -f MatthewsLiquor/Dockerfile .

# Entity Framework - scaffold database models
dotnet ef dbcontext scaffold "<connection-string>" Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer -o Models --force --project MatthewsLiquor
```

## Architecture Overview

This is a **data synchronization platform** built with ASP.NET Core 3.1 that synchronizes data across multiple external retail/POS systems:

- **OSF (Open Shop Front)** - Primary POS system
- **Epoints** - Loyalty/points system
- **Bepos** - BEPOS POS system
- **BI** - Business Intelligence data warehouse
- **Magento** - E-commerce platform

### Project Structure

```
MatthewsLiquor/
├── Areas/                    # Integration modules (one per external system)
│   ├── OSF/                  # OSF sync (Customers, Products, Sales, Inventory, etc.)
│   ├── Epoints/              # Epoints sync (Customers, Products, Promotions, etc.)
│   ├── Bepos/                # BEPOS sync
│   ├── BI/                   # Business Intelligence sync
│   ├── Mangento/             # Magento sync
│   ├── WebHook/              # Webhook handling
│   ├── Cronjob/              # Scheduled task management
│   ├── Dtos/                 # Data Transfer Objects
│   │   └── EF/               # Entity Framework models (70+ entities)
│   └── HangFire/             # Background job configuration (currently disabled)
├── Network/                  # HTTP client wrappers (BaseClient)
├── Services/                 # Shared services (AppSettings)
└── Helper/                   # Utility functions
```

### Key Patterns

- **Repository Pattern**: Each sync area has its own repositories (e.g., `ISyncOSFCustomerRepositories`, `ISyncEpointsProductRepositories`)
- **Multi-Database**: Three separate DbContexts for different databases:
  - `MatthewsLiquorDBContext` - Main application database
  - `BeposDBContext` - BEPOS database
  - `BIDBContext` - Business Intelligence database
- **Dependency Injection**: Uses built-in .NET DI with services registered in `Startup.cs`

### API Documentation

Swagger UI available at `/swagger` when running the application.

### Routes

- Areas follow: `/{area}/{controller}/{action}/{id?}`
- Default: `/{controller}/{action}/{id?}`

## Database Connections

Connection strings are configured in `appsettings.json`:
- `DefaultConnection` - Main matthewsliquor database
- `BeposConnection` - BEPOS database
- `BIConnection` - Business Intelligence database

## Logging

- Logs output to `Logs/` directory
- Configured via `nlog.config` (NLog) and `log4net.config`
- Sentry error tracking enabled

## Key Technologies

- .NET Core 3.1 (SDK 3.1.426 specified in `global.json`)
- Entity Framework Core 3.1 + Dapper
- Swashbuckle (Swagger)
- Sentry for error tracking
- GraphQL.Client for GraphQL integrations

[HttpPost("/webhook")]
public async Task<ActionResult> Webhook()
{
    try

        string body = "";

        }

    catch (Exception ex)

    }
    return NoContent();

3. WEBHOOK PROCESSING FLOW


Data Model:

Webhooks are stored in the database with the following structure:


[Table("WebHook")]
public class WebHooks
{
    public int Id { get; set; }
    public string Body { get; set; }
    public DateTime? CreatedAt { get; set; }
    public bool? IsProcess { get; set; }
    public bool? IsError { get; set; }
    public string WebhookId { get; set; }
    public string Event { get; set; }
    public string OSFCreatedAt { get; set; }
    public string Vendor { get; set; }
    public string OSFProductId { get; set; }
    public DateTime? ExecutedAt { get; set; }
    public string ErrorMessage { get; set; }
}



Processing Steps:


    

  1. Webhook Reception - HTTP POST captures raw JSON body
    2. 

  2. Parsing & Storage - InsertWebHook() extracts metadata (event type, vendor, timestamp, object ID)
    3. 

  3. Background Processing - Enqueued via Hangfire: BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => HandleWebhook(webhook))
    4. 

  4. Event Dispatching - HandleWebhook() uses switch statement on Event type
    5. 

  5. Handler Invocation - Specific handler processes the event (Customer, Product, Sale, etc.)
    6. 

  6. Downstream Sync - Background jobs enqueue syncs to Epoints, Bepos, and other systems
    7. 





4. WEBHOOK HANDLER PATTERN


Central Switch Statement Location: WebHookRepositories.HandleWebhook() (lines 194-308)


The pattern for event handling:


public async Task<ErrorHandle> HandleWebhook(WebHooks webHook)
{
    var obj = JObject.Parse(webHook.Body);
    string vendor = webHook.Vendor;
    string errorHandleMessage = "";
    
    switch (webHook.Event)
    {
        case Const.Webhook.ProductCreated:
            // Extract product name from payload
            string oSFProductName = obj["payload"]["name"].ToString();
            errorHandle = await _syncOSFProductRepositories.GetproductOSFByName(
                oSFProductName, vendor);
            if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 1)
            {
                // Async enqueue for downstream sync
                _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => 
                    _syncEpointsProductRepositories.CreateProductByProductName(
                        oSFProductName));
            }
            break;
            
        case Const.Webhook.ProductUpdate:
        case Const.Webhook.InventoryUpdate:
            // Deserialize payload to model
            ProductReponseModel updatedProduct = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<
                ProductReponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
            errorHandle = await ProductUpdated(updatedProduct, vendor);
            break;
            
        case Const.Webhook.CustomerCreated:
        case Const.Webhook.CustomerUpdated:
            CustomerResponseModel customerUpdateResponse = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<
                CustomerResponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
            errorHandle = await HandleCusomerEvent(customerUpdateResponse, vendor);
            break;
            
        case Const.Webhook.SaleModified:
        case Const.Webhook.SaleCreated:
        case Const.Webhook.SaleCabcelled:
            SaleResponseModel saleResponse = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<
                SaleResponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
            errorHandle = await HandleSaleCreatedEvent(saleResponse, vendor);
            break;
            
        // ... more cases
    }
    
    // Update webhook status
    webHook.IsProcess = true;
    webHook.ExecutedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorHandleMessage))
    {
        webHook.IsError = true;
        webHook.ErrorMessage = errorHandleMessage;
    }
    UpdateWebhook(webHook);
    return new ErrorHandle() { ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success };
}





5. EVENT HANDLER IMPLEMENTATIONS


Pattern for Individual Event Handlers:


All handlers follow this pattern:


    

  1. Receive response model - Deserialized from webhook payload
    2. 

  2. Insert/Update in OSF - Call OSF sync repository (e.g., InsertOrUpdateCustomer)
    3. 

  3. Check success - If ErrorCode == Success/Updated
    4. 

  4. Enqueue downstream - Background job to sync to other systems (Epoints, Bepos)
    5. 

  5. Return error handle - With status and message
    6. 



Example - Customer Event Handler:


private async Task<ErrorHandle> HandleCusomerEvent(
    CustomerResponseModel customerResponse, string vendor)
{
    // Step 1: Sync to OSF database
    var result = await _syncOSFCustomerRepositories.InsertOrUpdateCustomer(
        customerResponse, vendor);
    
    // Step 2: If successful, enqueue downstream sync
    if (result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success || 
        result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Updated)
    {
        // Async sync to Epoints system
        _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => 
            _syncEpointsCustomerRepositores.CreateOrUpdateCustomerToEpoints(
                customerResponse, vendor));
    }
    
    return new ErrorHandle()
    {
        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
        Message = $"HandleCusomerCreatedEvent Event đã tồn tại"
    };
}



Example - Sale Event Handler:


private async Task<ErrorHandle> HandleSaleCreatedEvent(
    SaleResponseModel saleResponse, string vendor)
{
    var result = await _syncOSFSaleRepositories.InsertOrUpdateSale(
        saleResponse, vendor);
    if (result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success || 
        result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Updated)
    {
        _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => 
            _syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories.CreateOrUpdatesaleOrderToEpoints(
                saleResponse, vendor));
    }
    return new ErrorHandle() { ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success };
}



Example - Product Event Handler:


public async Task<ErrorHandle> ProductUpdated(
    ProductReponseModel item, string domain)
{
    try
    {
        ErrorHandle<Product> result = await _syncOSFProductRepositories
            .CreateOrUpdateProductOSF(item, domain);
        if (result.Data != null)
        {
            await _syncEpointsProductRepositories.SyncProductToAllSite(result.Data);
        }
        return new ErrorHandle() { ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success };
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError($"Update Product - {ex.Message}");
        return new ErrorHandle() 
        { 
            ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
            Message = $"Update Product - {ex.Message}"
        };
    }
}





6. GRAPHQL CLIENT SETUP & API QUERIES


GraphQL Client Location: /Users/bangnb/Dev/DotNetWorkspaces/core-sync/MatthewsLiquor/Network/BaseClient.cs


Client Interface: /Users/bangnb/Dev/DotNetWorkspaces/core-sync/MatthewsLiquor/Network/IBaseClient.cs


GraphQL Call Method:


public async Task<dynamic> CallApiGraphql(string domain, 
    GraphQL.Common.Request.GraphQLRequest graphQLRequest)
{
    try
    {
        // Lookup site configuration by domain
        var objSite = _context.Setting
            .Where(x => x.OSF_Website == domain && x.Active == true)
            .FirstOrDefault();
        if (objSite != null)
        {
            return await CallGraphql(objSite, graphQLRequest);
        }
        return null;
    }
    catch (System.Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError($"GraphQLRefreshToken - {ex.Message}");
        return null;
    }
}

private async Task<dynamic> CallGraphql(Setting objSite, 
    GraphQL.Common.Request.GraphQLRequest graphQLRequest)
{
    try
    {
        // Build endpoint URL
        string tokenBear = $"Bearer {objSite.OSF_Access_Token}";
        string osfHost = _appSettings.Value.OSFHost;
        var graphQLClient = new GraphQLClient(
            $"https://{objSite.OSF_Website}.{osfHost}/api/v2/graphql");
        
        // Setup headers
        graphQLClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Clear();
        graphQLClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Add(
            new MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("application/json"));
        graphQLClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", tokenBear);
        
        // Execute query
        GraphQLResponse response = await graphQLClient.PostAsync(graphQLRequest);
        
        // Handle throttling
        if (response.Errors != null && response.Errors.Length > 0 && 
            response.Errors[0].Message == "Throttled")
        {
            _logger.LogError("Throttled " + graphQLRequest.OperationName);
            System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(30000);  // Wait 30 seconds
            response = await graphQLClient.PostAsync(graphQLRequest);
        }
        
        return response;
    }
    catch(Exception e)
    {
        _logger.LogError($"CallGraphql - {e.Message}");
    }
    return null;
}

var productsRequest = new GraphQLRequest
{
    Query = OSFResource.productQuery,  // Query string constant
    OperationName = "getProduct",       // GraphQL operation name
    Variables = new                     // Query variables
    {

        first = 50,
        ordering = new[] { new { sort = "updatedAt", direction = "desc" } }
    }
};

var productResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(domain, productsRequest);

// Process response
if (productResult != null && productResult.Data != null)
{
    EdgeResponseModel<NodeResponseModel<ProductReponseModel>> productRoot = 
        productResult.GetDataFieldAs<EdgeResponseModel<NodeResponseModel<
            ProductReponseModel>>>("products");
    
    foreach (var item in productRoot.Edges.Where(x => x != null).Select(x => x.Node))
    {
        await CreateOrUpdateProductOSF(item, domain);
    }
}

7. WEBHOOK RETRY MECHANISM


Location: WebHookRepositories.RetryWebhook() (lines 462-491)


public void RetryWebhook(string eventType)
{
    // Count unprocessed webhooks of specific event type
    var count = _context.WebHooks
        .Where(x => x.Event == eventType && x.IsProcess == false)
        .Count();
    
    // Paginate and re-enqueue
    int pageSize = 50;
    int totalPage = count / pageSize;
    if (count % pageSize != 0) totalPage++;
    
    for (int i = totalPage; i > 0; i--)
    {
        _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => 
            RetryWebhookPage(eventType, i, pageSize));
    }
}

public async Task RetryWebhookPage(string eventType, int page, int pageSize)
{
    var webHooks = _context.WebHooks
        .Where(x => x.Event == eventType && x.IsProcess == false)
        .Skip(page * pageSize)
        .Take(pageSize)
        .ToList();
    
    foreach (var webHook in webHooks)
    {
        await HandleWebhook(webHook);
        webHook.IsProcess = true;
    }
    _context.SaveChanges();
}



Exposed via HTTP:


[HttpGet("/retry")]
public ActionResult WebhookRetry(string eventType)
{
    _webHookRepositories.RetryWebhook(eventType);
    return NoContent();
}

9. BACKGROUND JOB QUEUE (Hangfire)


The system uses Hangfire for asynchronous processing:


// Immediate enqueue
_ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => HandleWebhook(webhook));

// Downstream syncs after successful OSF insert
_ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => 
    _syncEpointsCustomerRepositores.CreateOrUpdateCustomerToEpoints(
        customerResponse, vendor));



This allows:


    

  • Non-blocking webhook responses
    • 

  • Retry capability on failure
    • 

  • Distributed processing across multiple systems (Epoints, Bepos)
    •

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace MatthewsLiquor.Areas.WebHook.Controllers
{
    [Area("webhook")]
    [Route("webhook")]
    public class WebHookController : Controller
    {
        private readonly ILogger<WebHookController> _logger;
        private readonly IOptions<AppSettings> _appSettings;
        private readonly IWebHookRepositories _webHookRepositories;
        public WebHookController(IOptions<AppSettings> appSettings, IWebHookRepositories webHookRepositories, ILogger<WebHookController> logger)
        {

            _appSettings = appSettings;
            _logger = logger;
            _webHookRepositories = webHookRepositories;
        }

        [HttpPost("/webhook")]
        public async Task<ActionResult> Webhook()
        {
           try
           {
               string body = "";
               using (StreamReader stream = new StreamReader(Request.Body))
               {
                   body = await stream.ReadToEndAsync();
               }
               _ = _webHookRepositories.InsertWebHook(body);
           }
           catch (Exception ex)
           {
               _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
           }
          
           return NoContent();
        }

        [HttpGet("/test")]
        public async Task<ActionResult> WebhookTest(int id)
        {
           try
           {
           
               _ =  await _webHookRepositories.InsertWebHookTest(id);
           }
           catch (Exception ex)
           {
               _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
           }

           return NoContent();
        }

        [HttpGet("/retry")]
        public ActionResult WebhookRetry(string eventType)
        {
           try
           {
           
                _webHookRepositories.RetryWebhook(eventType);
           }
           catch (Exception ex)
           {
               _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
           }

           return NoContent();
        }

    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using GraphQL.Common.Request;
using Hangfire;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Bepos.Repositories.SyncBeposCustomer;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Dtos.EF;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Dtos.EF.Entities;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Models.Requests.SalleOrder;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncCustomer;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncInventory;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncProduct;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncPromotion;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncSale;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Models;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncCustomer;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncOrder;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncPromotion;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncSale;
using MatthewsLiquor.Resources;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.EF;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.EF.Entities;
using SyncData.Areas.Sync.Models;
using SyncData.Areas.Sync.Repositories.OSF.SyncProduct;
using SyncData.Network;
using SyncData.Resources;
using SyncData.Services;
using static MatthewsLiquor.Resources.Const;

namespace MatthewsLiquor.Areas.WebHook.Repositories
{
    public class WebHookRepositories : IWebHookRepositories
    {
        private readonly ILogger<WebHookRepositories> _logger;
        private readonly IBaseClient _client;
        private readonly IOptions<AppSettings> _appSettings;
        private readonly MatthewsLiquorDBContext _context;
        private readonly IConfiguration _config;
        private readonly IDapper _dapper;

        ISyncOSFCustomerRepositories _syncOSFCustomerRepositories;
        ISyncOSFProductRepositories _syncOSFProductRepositories;
        ISyncOSFSaleRepositories _syncOSFSaleRepositories;
        ISyncPromotionRepositories _syncOSFPromotionRepositories;
        ISyncOSFOrderRepositories _syncOSFOrderRepositories;

        ISyncEpointsCustomerRepositores _syncEpointsCustomerRepositores;
        ISyncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories _syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories;
        ISyncEpointsProductRepositories _syncEpointsProductRepositories;
        ISyncEpointsPromotionRepositories _syncEpointsPromotionRepositories;
        ISyncEpointsInventoryRepositories _syncEpointsInventoryRepositories;

        IBeposCustomerRepositories _beposCustomerRepositories;

        public WebHookRepositories(
            ILogger<WebHookRepositories> logger,
            IBaseClient client,
            IOptions<AppSettings> appSettings,
            MatthewsLiquorDBContext context,
            IConfiguration config,
            IDapper dapper,
            ISyncOSFCustomerRepositories syncOSFCustomerRepositories,
            ISyncOSFSaleRepositories syncOSFSaleRepositories,
            ISyncOSFProductRepositories syncOSFProductRepositories,
            ISyncPromotionRepositories syncOSFPromotionRepositories,
            ISyncOSFOrderRepositories syncOSFOrderRepositories,

            ISyncEpointsCustomerRepositores syncEpointsCustomerRepositores,
            ISyncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories,
            ISyncEpointsProductRepositories syncEpointsProductRepositories,
            ISyncEpointsPromotionRepositories syncEpointsPromotionRepositories,
            ISyncEpointsInventoryRepositories syncEpointsInventoryRepositories,

            IBeposCustomerRepositories beposCustomerRepositories)
        {
            _logger = logger;
            _client = client;
            _appSettings = appSettings;
            _context = context;
            _config = config;
            _dapper = dapper;
            _syncOSFCustomerRepositories = syncOSFCustomerRepositories;
            _syncEpointsCustomerRepositores = syncEpointsCustomerRepositores;
            _syncOSFSaleRepositories = syncOSFSaleRepositories;
            _syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories = syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories;
            _syncEpointsProductRepositories = syncEpointsProductRepositories;
            _syncOSFPromotionRepositories = syncOSFPromotionRepositories;
            _syncEpointsPromotionRepositories = syncEpointsPromotionRepositories;
            _syncOSFProductRepositories = syncOSFProductRepositories;
            _beposCustomerRepositories = beposCustomerRepositories;
            _syncOSFOrderRepositories = syncOSFOrderRepositories;
            _syncEpointsInventoryRepositories = syncEpointsInventoryRepositories;
        }
        public async Task<ErrorHandle> InsertWebHookTest(int id)
        {
            try
            {
                var webHook = _context.WebHooks.Where(x => x.Id == id).FirstOrDefault();
                _ = await HandleWebhook(webHook);
                //
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"Insert Webhook thành công"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = ex.Message
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> HandlePromotionCreatedEvent(PromotionResponseModel promotionResponse, string vendor)
        {
            var result = await _syncOSFPromotionRepositories.InsertOrUpdatePromotion(promotionResponse, vendor);
            if (result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success || result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Updated)
            {
                _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncEpointsPromotionRepositories.CreateOrUpdatePromotionToEpoints(promotionResponse, vendor));
                //_ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncOdooSaleRepositories.CreateOdooSale(saleResponse, vendor));
            }

            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                Message = $"HandleCusomerCreatedEvent thành công"
            };
        }

        public ErrorHandle InsertWebHook(string bodyJon)
        {

            try
            {
                var obj = JObject.Parse(bodyJon);
                var webhookId = obj["id"].ToString();
                var oSFEvent = obj["event"].ToString();
                var oSFCreatedAt = obj["timestamp"].ToString();
                var vendor = obj["vendor"].ToString();
                var objectID = obj["payload"]["id"].ToString();
                _logger.LogError("Webhook Id " + webhookId);

                var webhook = new WebHooks
                {
                    Body = bodyJon,
                    CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    IsProcess = false,
                    WebhookId = webhookId,
                    Event = oSFEvent,
                    OSFCreatedAt = oSFCreatedAt,
                    Vendor = vendor,
                    OSFProductId = objectID
                };
                _context.WebHooks.Add(webhook);
                var result = _context.SaveChanges();
                if (result > 0)
                {
                    _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => HandleWebhook(webhook));
                    return new ErrorHandle()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                        Message = $"Insert Webhook thành công"
                    };
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $""
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"{ex.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> HandleWebhook(WebHooks webHook)
        {
            //
            var obj = JObject.Parse(webHook.Body);
            string vendor = webHook.Vendor;
            string oSFProductName = "";
            ErrorHandle errorHandle = null;
            string errorHandleMessage = "";
            switch (webHook.Event)
            {
                case Const.Webhook.ProductCreated:
                    oSFProductName = obj["payload"]["name"].ToString();
                    errorHandle = await _syncOSFProductRepositories.GetproductOSFByName(oSFProductName, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 1)
                    {
                        _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncEpointsProductRepositories.CreateProductByProductName(oSFProductName));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;

                case Const.Webhook.ProductUpdate:
                case Const.Webhook.InventoryUpdate:
                    ProductReponseModel updatedProduct = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ProductReponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    errorHandle = await ProductUpdated(updatedProduct, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 0)
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;

                case Const.Webhook.ProductDeleted:
                    ProductReponseModel deletedProduct = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ProductReponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    deletedProduct.Active = false;
                    deletedProduct.Status = "DELETED";

                    errorHandle = await ProductUpdated(deletedProduct, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 0)
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;

                case Const.Webhook.CustomerCreated:
                case Const.Webhook.CustomerUpdated:
                    CustomerResponseModel customerUpdateResponse = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<CustomerResponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    errorHandle = await HandleCusomerEvent(customerUpdateResponse, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 0)
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;
                case Const.Webhook.CustomerDeleted:
                    CustomerResponseModel deletedCustomer = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<CustomerResponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    deletedCustomer.DeletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    errorHandle = await HandleCusomerEvent(deletedCustomer, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 0)
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;
                case Const.Webhook.SaleModified:
                case Const.Webhook.SaleCreated:
                case Const.Webhook.SaleCabcelled:
                    SaleResponseModel saleResponse = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SaleResponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    errorHandle = await HandleSaleCreatedEvent(saleResponse, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 0)
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;
                case Const.Webhook.OrderSent:
                case Const.Webhook.OrderReceived:
                    OrderReponseModel orderResponse = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<OrderReponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    ErrorHandle<Order> result = await _syncOSFOrderRepositories.InsertOrUpdateOrder(orderResponse, vendor);
                    if (result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success)
                    {
                        if (orderResponse.Type == "TRANSFER")
                        {
                            await _syncEpointsInventoryRepositories.CreateTransferToSite(orderResponse, vendor);
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += result.Message;
                    }
                    break;
                case Const.Webhook.Payment:
                    CustomerPaymentResponseModel customerPayment = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<CustomerPaymentResponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    errorHandle = await HandleCustomerPaymentEvent(customerPayment, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 0)
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            //
            webHook.IsProcess = true;
            webHook.ExecutedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorHandleMessage))
            {
                webHook.IsError = true;
                webHook.ErrorMessage = errorHandleMessage;
            }
            UpdateWebhook(webHook);
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                Message = $"Insert Webhook thành công"
            };
        }

        public ErrorHandle UpdateWebhook(WebHooks webHook)
        {
            try
            {
                WebHooks objWebhook = _context.WebHooks.Where(x => x.WebhookId == webHook.WebhookId).FirstOrDefault();
                if (objWebhook != null)
                {
                    objWebhook.IsProcess = webHook.IsProcess;
                    objWebhook.ExecutedAt = webHook.ExecutedAt;
                    objWebhook.IsError = webHook.IsError;
                    objWebhook.ErrorMessage = webHook.ErrorMessage;
                    _context.SaveChanges();
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"Insert Webhook thành công"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"UpdateWebhook: {ex.Message}");
            }
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                Message = $"Insert Webhook thành công"
            };
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> HandleCustomerPaymentEvent(CustomerPaymentResponseModel customerPayment, string vendor)
        {
            try
            {
                var result = await _syncOSFSaleRepositories.InsertOrUpdateCustomerPayment(customerPayment, vendor);
                if (result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success)
                {
                    foreach (var item in customerPayment.Payments)
                    {
                        if (item.Sale != null)
                        {
                            await _syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories.CreateOrUpdatesaleOrderToEpoints(item.Sale, vendor);
                        }
                    }
                }
                return result;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"HandleCustomerPaymentEvent - {ex.Message}");
            }
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                Message = $"HandleCusomerCreatedEvent thất bại"
            };
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> ProductUpdated(ProductReponseModel item, string domain)
        {
            try
            {
                ErrorHandle<Product> result = await _syncOSFProductRepositories.CreateOrUpdateProductOSF(item, domain);
                if (result.Data != null)
                {
                    await _syncEpointsProductRepositories.SyncProductToAllSite(result.Data);
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"HandleCusomerCreatedEvent thất bại"
                }; ;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"Update Product - {ex.Message} - ProductId {item.Id}");
                //_ = await Helper.SendMessage($"Update Product - {ex.Message} - ProductId {item.Id}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"Update Product - {ex.Message} - ProductId {item.Id}"
                }; ;
            }

        }

        private async Task<ErrorHandle> HandleCusomerEvent(CustomerResponseModel customerResponse, string vendor)
        {
            var result = await _syncOSFCustomerRepositories.InsertOrUpdateCustomer(customerResponse, vendor);
            if (result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success || result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Updated)
            {
                // Sync customer qua epoints
                _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncEpointsCustomerRepositores.CreateOrUpdateCustomerToEpoints(customerResponse, vendor));

            }
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                Message = $"HandleCusomerCreatedEvent Event đã tồn tại"
            };
        }

        public async Task DeleteCustomer(string id)
        {
            using (var db = new MatthewsLiquorDBContext())
            {
                var customers = db.Customer.Where(o => o.FirstName == "Thirsty Footy Tipping" && o.CustomerId != "11ec9a9b42f860ae931b026582b6d3d2").ToList();
                var sites = db.Setting.ToList();
                foreach (var customer in customers)
                {
                    var site = sites.Where(o => o.OSF_Website == customer.SubDomain).FirstOrDefault();
                    if (site != null)
                    {
                        var createCustomerRequest = new GraphQLRequest
                        {
                            Query = OSFResource.deleteCusstomerQuery,
                            OperationName = "deleteCustomer",
                            Variables = new
                            {
                                id = customer.CustomerId
                            }
                        };
                        var productResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(
                            site.OSF_Website,
                            createCustomerRequest);
                        if (productResult.Errors == null)
                        {
                            _logger.LogError($"Xóa KH: {customer.CustomerId}, Sub {customer.SubDomain}");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }


        private async Task<ErrorHandle> HandleSaleCreatedEvent(SaleResponseModel saleResponse, string vendor)
        {
            var result = await _syncOSFSaleRepositories.InsertOrUpdateSale(saleResponse, vendor);
            if (result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success || result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Updated)
            {
                _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories.CreateOrUpdatesaleOrderToEpoints(saleResponse, vendor));
                //_ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncOdooSaleRepositories.CreateOdooSale(saleResponse, vendor));
            }

            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                Message = $"HandleCusomerCreatedEvent thành công"
            };
        }

        public void RetryWebhook(string eventType)
        {
            var count = _context.WebHooks.Where(x => x.Event == eventType && x.IsProcess == false).Count();
            int pageSize = 50;
            int totalPage = count / pageSize;
            if (count % pageSize != 0)
            {
                totalPage++;
            }
            for (int i = totalPage; i > 0; i--)
            {
                _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => RetryWebhookPage(eventType, i, pageSize));

            }
        }

        public async Task RetryWebhookPage(string eventType, int page, int pageSize)
        {
            var webHooks = _context.WebHooks.Where(x => x.Event == eventType && x.IsProcess == false)
                                            .Skip(page * pageSize)
                                            .Take(pageSize)
                                            .ToList();

            foreach (var webHook in webHooks)
            {
                await HandleWebhook(webHook);
                webHook.IsProcess = true;
            }
            _context.SaveChanges();
        }
    }

}

        public async Task<int> FrefeshTokenMagento()
        {
            try
            {
                string bodyJson = "{\r\n    \"username\": \"" + _appSettings.Value.MagentoUser + "\", \"password\": \"" + _appSettings.Value.MagentoPassword + "\"  }\r\n";
                string uri = _appSettings.Value.DomainMagento + "/rest/V1/integration/admin/token";
                HttpClient client = new HttpClient();
                client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("cache-control", "no-cache");
                client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("accept", "application/json");
                var httpContent = new StringContent(bodyJson, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                HttpResponseMessage response = await client.PostAsync(uri, httpContent);
                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    string apiResponse = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    string result = Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.DeserializeObject(apiResponse).ToString();
                    var cacheEntryOptions = new MemoryCacheEntryOptions()
                                // Keep in cache for this time, reset time if accessed.
                                .SetSlidingExpiration(TimeSpan.FromDays(300));

                    // Save data in cache.
                    _cache.Set("TokenMagento", result, cacheEntryOptions);
                    return 1;

                }
                return 0;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
                return 0;
            }
        }

        public async Task<dynamic> PutApiMagento(string url, string jsonString)
        {
            dynamic result = null;
            try
            {
                string token;
                _cache.TryGetValue("TokenMagento", out token);
                string tokenBear = $"Bearer {token}";
                HttpClient client = new HttpClient();
                client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("cache-control", "no-cache");
                client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("accept", "application/json");
                client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("authorization", tokenBear);
                var httpContent = new StringContent(jsonString, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
                HttpResponseMessage response = await client.PutAsync(url, httpContent);
                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    string apiResponse = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    result = Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert.DeserializeObject(apiResponse);

                }
                else
                {
                    _ = await Helper.SendMessage($"Call Api Magento : {response} - {jsonString}");
                    if (response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized)
                    {
                        var resultFrefesh = await FrefeshTokenMagento();
                        if (resultFrefesh == 1)
                        {
                            return await PutApiMagento(url, jsonString);
                        }
                    }
                }
                return result;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
                return null;
            }
        }

        public async Task<dynamic> CallGraphql(Setting objSite, GraphQL.Common.Request.GraphQLRequest graphQLRequest)
        {
            try
            {
                string tokenBear = $"Bearer {objSite.OSF_Access_Token}";
                string osfHost = _appSettings.Value.OSFHost;
                var graphQLClient = new GraphQLClient($"https://{objSite.OSF_Website}.{osfHost}/api/v2/graphql");
                graphQLClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Clear();
                graphQLClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Add(new MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("application/json"));
                graphQLClient.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", tokenBear);
                GraphQLResponse response = await graphQLClient.PostAsync(graphQLRequest);

                if (response.Errors != null && response.Errors.Length > 0 && response.Errors[0].Message == "Throttled")
                {

                    _logger.LogError("Throttled " + graphQLRequest.OperationName + " from SHOPFRONT: " + response.Errors[0].Message);
                    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(30000);
                    response = await graphQLClient.PostAsync(graphQLRequest);
                }

                if (response.Data == null && response.Errors == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogError("Empty " + graphQLRequest.OperationName + " from SHOPFRONT - ignored");
                    return null;

                }
                return response;
            }catch(Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"CallGraphql - {e.Message}");
            }
            return null;
        }

        public async Task<dynamic> CallApiGraphql(Setting objSite, GraphQL.Common.Request.GraphQLRequest graphQLRequest)
        {

            try
            {
                if (objSite != null)
                {
                    return await CallGraphql(objSite, graphQLRequest);
                }
                return null;
            }
            catch (System.Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"GraphQLRefreshToken - {ex.Message}");
                return null;
            }

        }

        public async Task<dynamic> CallApiGraphql(string domain, GraphQL.Common.Request.GraphQLRequest graphQLRequest)
        {

            try
            {
                var objSite = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.OSF_Website == domain && x.Active == true).FirstOrDefault();
                if (objSite != null)
                {
                    return await CallGraphql(objSite, graphQLRequest);
                }
                return null;
            }
            catch (System.Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"GraphQLRefreshToken - {ex.Message}");
                return null;
            }

        }

        public string PostApiOdoo(string url, string path, string sesstionId, string jsonString)
        {
            var client = new RestClient(url + path);
            var request = new RestRequest(Method.POST);

            request.AddHeader("cache-control", "no-cache");
            request.AddHeader("x-requested-with", "XMLHttpRequest");
            request.AddHeader("user-agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/89.0.4389.90 Safari/537.36");
            request.AddHeader("sec-fetch-site", "same-origin");
            request.AddHeader("sec-fetch-mode", "cors");
            request.AddHeader("sec-fetch-dest", "empty");
            request.AddHeader("sec-ch-ua-mobile", "?0");
            request.AddHeader("sec-ch-ua", "\"Google Chrome\";v=\"89\", \"Chromium\";v=\"89\", \";Not A Brand\";v=\"99\"");
            request.AddHeader("referer", url + "web");
            request.AddHeader("origin", url);
            request.AddHeader("cookie", "_ga=GA1.3.266320205.1615868554; _fbp=fb.2.1615868553881.1352939587; session_id=" + sesstionId + "; cids=2,1,3");
            request.AddHeader("content-type", "application/json");
            request.AddHeader("content-length", "1552");
            request.AddHeader("accept-language", "vi,en-US;q=0.9,en;q=0.8");
            request.AddHeader("accept-encoding", "gzip, deflate, br");
            request.AddHeader("accept", "application/json, text/javascript, */*; q=0.01");
            request.AddParameter("application/json", jsonString, ParameterType.RequestBody);

            _logger.LogError($"Error: {jsonString}");
            IRestResponse response = client.Execute(request);

            if(response.StatusCode == System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK)
            {
                string responseStr = response.Content;
                return responseStr;
            }


            _logger.LogError($"Error: {path}");
            _logger.LogError(response.Content);
            return "";
            
        }

        public async Task<dynamic> postXML(string url, string mac, string xmlString)
        {
            dynamic result = null;
            try
            {
                HttpClient client = new HttpClient();
                client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("cache-control", "no-cache");
                client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("accept", "application/json");

                byte[] bodyByte = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(xmlString);
                byte[] macByte = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(mac);

                client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("mac", MacEncode(bodyByte, macByte));
                StringContent httpContent = new StringContent(xmlString, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8, "application/xml");
                HttpResponseMessage response = await client.PostAsync(url, httpContent);
                if (response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                {
                    string apiResponse = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                    result = apiResponse;
                    //result = Newtonsoft.XML.JsonConvert.DeserializeObject(apiResponse);

                }
                else
                {
                    _logger.LogError($"Error: {response.Content}");
                }
                return result;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
                return null;
            }
        }

        public string MacEncode(byte[] body, byte[] secret)
        {
            using (HMACSHA1 hmac = new HMACSHA1(secret))
            {
                byte[] signatureBytes = hmac.ComputeHash(body);
                string hexSignature = BitConverter.ToString(signatureBytes).ToLowerInvariant().Replace("-", "");
                return hexSignature.ToUpper();
            }
        }
    }
