    public class SyncOSFProductRepositories : ISyncOSFProductRepositories
    {
        private readonly MatthewsLiquorDBContext _context;
        private readonly IBaseClient _client;
        private readonly ILogger<SyncOSFProductRepositories> _logger;
        private readonly IDapper _dapper;

        public SyncOSFProductRepositories(
            MatthewsLiquorDBContext context,
            IBaseClient client,
            ILogger<SyncOSFProductRepositories> logger,
            IDapper dapper
            )
        {
            _logger = logger;
            _client = client;
            _context = context;
            _dapper = dapper;
        }

        public ErrorHandle GetProductFromOSFByDate(int date)
        {
            var setting = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.Active == true).ToList();

            foreach (var item in setting)
            {
                var jobId = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => GetProductFormOSFDomainByDate(item.OSF_Website, date));
            }
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                Message = $"GetAllProductFromOSF Success"
            };
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> GetProductFormOSFDomainByDate(string domain, int date)
        {
            try
            {
                var endPageCursor = "";
                var hasNextItem = false;
                do
                {
                    DateTime currentDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-1);
                    Object[] orderingInput = {
                        new { sort = "updatedAt", direction = "desc" } };
                    var productsRequest = new GraphQLRequest
                    {
                        Query = OSFResource.productQuery,
                        OperationName = "getProduct",
                        Variables = new
                        {
                            after = string.IsNullOrEmpty(endPageCursor) ? "" : endPageCursor,
                            first = 50,
                            ordering = orderingInput
                        }
                    };
                    var productResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(
                        domain,
                        productsRequest);
                    if (productResult != null && productResult.Data != null)
                    {

                        EdgeResponseModel<NodeResponseModel<ProductReponseModel>> productRoot = productResult.GetDataFieldAs<EdgeResponseModel<NodeResponseModel<ProductReponseModel>>>("products");

                        foreach (var item in productRoot.Edges.Where(x => x != null).Select(x => x.Node))
                        {

                            await CreateOrUpdateProductOSF(item, domain);

                            if (date > 0 && item.UpdatedAt.Value.Date < currentDate.Date)
                            {
                                hasNextItem = false;
                                _logger.LogInformation($"GetProductFormOSFDomainByDate - {domain}: END: {item.Id} - {item.UpdatedAt}");
                                return new ErrorHandle()
                                {
                                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                                    Message = $"GetProductFormOSFDomainByDate End Item: {item.Id} - {item.UpdatedAt}"
                                };
                            }
                        }
                        hasNextItem = productRoot.PageInfo.HasNextPage;
                        endPageCursor = productRoot.PageInfo.EndCursor;
                        _logger.LogInformation($"GetProductFormOSFDomainByDate - {domain} - page : {endPageCursor}");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        hasNextItem = false;
                        _logger.LogError($"GetProductFormOSFDomainByDate - {domain}: ERROR: {productResult.Errors[0]}");
                        return new ErrorHandle()
                        {
                            ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                            Message = "GetProductFormOSFDomainByDate Error"
                        };
                    }
                } while (hasNextItem);


                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"GetProductFormOSFDomainByDate Success- {domain} - Page : {endPageCursor}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation($"GetProductFormOSFDomainByDate- {domain} - Error - Message: {ex.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = ex.Message
                };
            }
        }

        public ErrorHandle GetAllProductFromOSF()
        {
            var setting = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.Active == true).ToList();

            foreach (var item in setting)
            {
                var jobId = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => GetProductFormOSFDomainByDate(item.OSF_Website, 0));
            }
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                Message = $"GetAllProductFromOSF Success"
            };
        }

using System;

using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Bepos.Repositories.SyncBeposCustomer;

using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Dtos.EF.Entities;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Models.Requests.SalleOrder;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncCustomer;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncInventory;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncProduct;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncPromotion;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Epoints.Repositories.SyncSale;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Models;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncCustomer;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncOrder;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncPromotion;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncSale;
using MatthewsLiquor.Resources;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.EF;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.EF.Entities;
using SyncData.Areas.Sync.Models;
using SyncData.Areas.Sync.Repositories.OSF.SyncProduct;
using SyncData.Network;
using SyncData.Resources;
using SyncData.Services;
using static MatthewsLiquor.Resources.Const;

namespace MatthewsLiquor.Areas.WebHook.Repositories
{
    public class WebHookRepositories : IWebHookRepositories
    {
        private readonly ILogger<WebHookRepositories> _logger;
        private readonly IBaseClient _client;
        private readonly IOptions<AppSettings> _appSettings;
        private readonly MatthewsLiquorDBContext _context;
        private readonly IConfiguration _config;
        private readonly IDapper _dapper;

        ISyncOSFCustomerRepositories _syncOSFCustomerRepositories;
        ISyncOSFProductRepositories _syncOSFProductRepositories;
        ISyncOSFSaleRepositories _syncOSFSaleRepositories;
        ISyncPromotionRepositories _syncOSFPromotionRepositories;
        ISyncOSFOrderRepositories _syncOSFOrderRepositories;

        ISyncEpointsCustomerRepositores _syncEpointsCustomerRepositores;
        ISyncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories _syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories;
        ISyncEpointsProductRepositories _syncEpointsProductRepositories;
        ISyncEpointsPromotionRepositories _syncEpointsPromotionRepositories;
        ISyncEpointsInventoryRepositories _syncEpointsInventoryRepositories;

        IBeposCustomerRepositories _beposCustomerRepositories;

        public WebHookRepositories(
            ILogger<WebHookRepositories> logger,
            IBaseClient client,
            IOptions<AppSettings> appSettings,
            MatthewsLiquorDBContext context,
            IConfiguration config,
            IDapper dapper,
            ISyncOSFCustomerRepositories syncOSFCustomerRepositories,
            ISyncOSFSaleRepositories syncOSFSaleRepositories,
            ISyncOSFProductRepositories syncOSFProductRepositories,
            ISyncPromotionRepositories syncOSFPromotionRepositories,
            ISyncOSFOrderRepositories syncOSFOrderRepositories,

            ISyncEpointsCustomerRepositores syncEpointsCustomerRepositores,
            ISyncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories,
            ISyncEpointsProductRepositories syncEpointsProductRepositories,
            ISyncEpointsPromotionRepositories syncEpointsPromotionRepositories,
            ISyncEpointsInventoryRepositories syncEpointsInventoryRepositories,

            IBeposCustomerRepositories beposCustomerRepositories)
        {
            _logger = logger;
            _client = client;
            _appSettings = appSettings;
            _context = context;
            _config = config;
            _dapper = dapper;
            _syncOSFCustomerRepositories = syncOSFCustomerRepositories;
            _syncEpointsCustomerRepositores = syncEpointsCustomerRepositores;
            _syncOSFSaleRepositories = syncOSFSaleRepositories;
            _syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories = syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories;
            _syncEpointsProductRepositories = syncEpointsProductRepositories;
            _syncOSFPromotionRepositories = syncOSFPromotionRepositories;
            _syncEpointsPromotionRepositories = syncEpointsPromotionRepositories;
            _syncOSFProductRepositories = syncOSFProductRepositories;
            _beposCustomerRepositories = beposCustomerRepositories;
            _syncOSFOrderRepositories = syncOSFOrderRepositories;
            _syncEpointsInventoryRepositories = syncEpointsInventoryRepositories;
        }
        public async Task<ErrorHandle> InsertWebHookTest(int id)
        {
            try
            {
                var webHook = _context.WebHooks.Where(x => x.Id == id).FirstOrDefault();
                _ = await HandleWebhook(webHook);
                //
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"Insert Webhook thành công"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = ex.Message
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> HandlePromotionCreatedEvent(PromotionResponseModel promotionResponse, string vendor)
        {
            var result = await _syncOSFPromotionRepositories.InsertOrUpdatePromotion(promotionResponse, vendor);
            if (result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success || result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Updated)
            {
                _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncEpointsPromotionRepositories.CreateOrUpdatePromotionToEpoints(promotionResponse, vendor));
                //_ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncOdooSaleRepositories.CreateOdooSale(saleResponse, vendor));
            }

            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                Message = $"HandleCusomerCreatedEvent thành công"
            };
        }

        public ErrorHandle InsertWebHook(string bodyJon)
        {

            try
            {
                var obj = JObject.Parse(bodyJon);
                var webhookId = obj["id"].ToString();
                var oSFEvent = obj["event"].ToString();
                var oSFCreatedAt = obj["timestamp"].ToString();
                var vendor = obj["vendor"].ToString();
                var objectID = obj["payload"]["id"].ToString();
                _logger.LogError("Webhook Id " + webhookId);

                var webhook = new WebHooks
                {
                    Body = bodyJon,
                    CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    IsProcess = false,
                    WebhookId = webhookId,
                    Event = oSFEvent,
                    OSFCreatedAt = oSFCreatedAt,
                    Vendor = vendor,
                    OSFProductId = objectID
                };
                _context.WebHooks.Add(webhook);
                var result = _context.SaveChanges();
                if (result > 0)
                {
                    _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => HandleWebhook(webhook));
                    return new ErrorHandle()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                        Message = $"Insert Webhook thành công"
                    };
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $""
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"{ex.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> HandleWebhook(WebHooks webHook)
        {
            //
            var obj = JObject.Parse(webHook.Body);
            string vendor = webHook.Vendor;
            string oSFProductName = "";
            ErrorHandle errorHandle = null;
            string errorHandleMessage = "";
            switch (webHook.Event)
            {
                case Const.Webhook.ProductCreated:
                    oSFProductName = obj["payload"]["name"].ToString();
                    errorHandle = await _syncOSFProductRepositories.GetproductOSFByName(oSFProductName, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 1)
                    {
                        _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncEpointsProductRepositories.CreateProductByProductName(oSFProductName));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;

                case Const.Webhook.ProductUpdate:
                case Const.Webhook.InventoryUpdate:
                    ProductReponseModel updatedProduct = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ProductReponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    errorHandle = await ProductUpdated(updatedProduct, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 0)
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;

                case Const.Webhook.ProductDeleted:
                    ProductReponseModel deletedProduct = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<ProductReponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    deletedProduct.Active = false;
                    deletedProduct.Status = "DELETED";

                    errorHandle = await ProductUpdated(deletedProduct, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 0)
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;

                case Const.Webhook.CustomerCreated:
                case Const.Webhook.CustomerUpdated:
                    CustomerResponseModel customerUpdateResponse = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<CustomerResponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    errorHandle = await HandleCusomerEvent(customerUpdateResponse, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 0)
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;
                case Const.Webhook.CustomerDeleted:
                    CustomerResponseModel deletedCustomer = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<CustomerResponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    deletedCustomer.DeletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    errorHandle = await HandleCusomerEvent(deletedCustomer, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 0)
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;
                case Const.Webhook.SaleModified:
                case Const.Webhook.SaleCreated:
                case Const.Webhook.SaleCabcelled:
                    SaleResponseModel saleResponse = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<SaleResponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    errorHandle = await HandleSaleCreatedEvent(saleResponse, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 0)
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;
                case Const.Webhook.OrderSent:
                case Const.Webhook.OrderReceived:
                    OrderReponseModel orderResponse = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<OrderReponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    ErrorHandle<Order> result = await _syncOSFOrderRepositories.InsertOrUpdateOrder(orderResponse, vendor);
                    if (result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success)
                    {
                        if (orderResponse.Type == "TRANSFER")
                        {
                            await _syncEpointsInventoryRepositories.CreateTransferToSite(orderResponse, vendor);
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += result.Message;
                    }
                    break;
                case Const.Webhook.Payment:
                    CustomerPaymentResponseModel customerPayment = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<CustomerPaymentResponseModel>(obj["payload"].ToString());
                    errorHandle = await HandleCustomerPaymentEvent(customerPayment, vendor);
                    if (errorHandle.ErrorCode == 0)
                    {
                        errorHandleMessage += errorHandle.Message;
                    }
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
            //
            webHook.IsProcess = true;
            webHook.ExecutedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorHandleMessage))
            {
                webHook.IsError = true;
                webHook.ErrorMessage = errorHandleMessage;
            }
            UpdateWebhook(webHook);
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                Message = $"Insert Webhook thành công"
            };
        }

        public ErrorHandle UpdateWebhook(WebHooks webHook)
        {
            try
            {
                WebHooks objWebhook = _context.WebHooks.Where(x => x.WebhookId == webHook.WebhookId).FirstOrDefault();
                if (objWebhook != null)
                {
                    objWebhook.IsProcess = webHook.IsProcess;
                    objWebhook.ExecutedAt = webHook.ExecutedAt;
                    objWebhook.IsError = webHook.IsError;
                    objWebhook.ErrorMessage = webHook.ErrorMessage;
                    _context.SaveChanges();
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"Insert Webhook thành công"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"UpdateWebhook: {ex.Message}");
            }
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                Message = $"Insert Webhook thành công"
            };
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> HandleCustomerPaymentEvent(CustomerPaymentResponseModel customerPayment, string vendor)
        {
            try
            {
                var result = await _syncOSFSaleRepositories.InsertOrUpdateCustomerPayment(customerPayment, vendor);
                if (result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success)
                {
                    foreach (var item in customerPayment.Payments)
                    {
                        if (item.Sale != null)
                        {
                            await _syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories.CreateOrUpdatesaleOrderToEpoints(item.Sale, vendor);
                        }
                    }
                }
                return result;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"HandleCustomerPaymentEvent - {ex.Message}");
            }
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                Message = $"HandleCusomerCreatedEvent thất bại"
            };
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> ProductUpdated(ProductReponseModel item, string domain)
        {
            try
            {
                ErrorHandle<Product> result = await _syncOSFProductRepositories.CreateOrUpdateProductOSF(item, domain);
                if (result.Data != null)
                {
                    await _syncEpointsProductRepositories.SyncProductToAllSite(result.Data);
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"HandleCusomerCreatedEvent thất bại"
                }; ;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"Update Product - {ex.Message} - ProductId {item.Id}");
                //_ = await Helper.SendMessage($"Update Product - {ex.Message} - ProductId {item.Id}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"Update Product - {ex.Message} - ProductId {item.Id}"
                }; ;
            }

        }

        private async Task<ErrorHandle> HandleCusomerEvent(CustomerResponseModel customerResponse, string vendor)
        {
            var result = await _syncOSFCustomerRepositories.InsertOrUpdateCustomer(customerResponse, vendor);
            if (result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success || result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Updated)
            {
                // Sync customer qua epoints
                _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncEpointsCustomerRepositores.CreateOrUpdateCustomerToEpoints(customerResponse, vendor));

            }
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                Message = $"HandleCusomerCreatedEvent Event đã tồn tại"
            };
        }

        public async Task DeleteCustomer(string id)
        {
            using (var db = new MatthewsLiquorDBContext())
            {
                var customers = db.Customer.Where(o => o.FirstName == "Thirsty Footy Tipping" && o.CustomerId != "11ec9a9b42f860ae931b026582b6d3d2").ToList();
                var sites = db.Setting.ToList();
                foreach (var customer in customers)
                {
                    var site = sites.Where(o => o.OSF_Website == customer.SubDomain).FirstOrDefault();
                    if (site != null)
                    {
                        var createCustomerRequest = new GraphQLRequest
                        {
                            Query = OSFResource.deleteCusstomerQuery,
                            OperationName = "deleteCustomer",
                            Variables = new
                            {
                                id = customer.CustomerId
                            }
                        };
                        var productResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(
                            site.OSF_Website,
                            createCustomerRequest);
                        if (productResult.Errors == null)
                        {
                            _logger.LogError($"Xóa KH: {customer.CustomerId}, Sub {customer.SubDomain}");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }


        private async Task<ErrorHandle> HandleSaleCreatedEvent(SaleResponseModel saleResponse, string vendor)
        {
            var result = await _syncOSFSaleRepositories.InsertOrUpdateSale(saleResponse, vendor);
            if (result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success || result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Updated)
            {
                _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories.CreateOrUpdatesaleOrderToEpoints(saleResponse, vendor));
                //_ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncOdooSaleRepositories.CreateOdooSale(saleResponse, vendor));
            }

            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                Message = $"HandleCusomerCreatedEvent thành công"
            };
        }

        public void RetryWebhook(string eventType)
        {
            var count = _context.WebHooks.Where(x => x.Event == eventType && x.IsProcess == false).Count();
            int pageSize = 50;
            int totalPage = count / pageSize;
            if (count % pageSize != 0)
            {
                totalPage++;
            }
            for (int i = totalPage; i > 0; i--)
            {
                _ = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => RetryWebhookPage(eventType, i, pageSize));

            }
        }

        public async Task RetryWebhookPage(string eventType, int page, int pageSize)
        {
            var webHooks = _context.WebHooks.Where(x => x.Event == eventType && x.IsProcess == false)
                                            .Skip(page * pageSize)
                                            .Take(pageSize)
                                            .ToList();

            foreach (var webHook in webHooks)
            {
                await HandleWebhook(webHook);
                webHook.IsProcess = true;
            }
            _context.SaveChanges();
        }
    }

}

        public string Reference { get; set; }
        
        [JsonProperty("status")]

        [JsonProperty("startBalance")]
        public double StartBalance { get; set; }

        [JsonProperty("amount")]
        public double Amount { get; set; }

        [JsonProperty("rounding")]
        public double Rounding { get; set; }

        [JsonProperty("timestamp")]
        public DateTime Timestamp { get; set; }

        [JsonProperty("relatesTo")]
        public CustomerPaymentResponseModel? RelatesTo { get; set; }

        [JsonProperty("payments")]
        public List<PaymentResponseModel> Payments { get; set; }

        [JsonProperty("cancelledAt")]
        public DateTime? CancelledAt { get; set; }

        }
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data;

using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Models.Responses.SaleOrder;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncCustomer;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncUser;
using MatthewsLiquor.Resources;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.Bepos.Entities;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.EF;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.EF.Entities;
using SyncData.Areas.Sync.Models;
using SyncData.Network;
using SyncData.Resources;

namespace MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncSale
{
    public class SyncOSFSaleRepositories : ISyncOSFSaleRepositories
    {

        private readonly MatthewsLiquorDBContext _context;
        private readonly IBaseClient _client;
        private readonly ILogger<SyncOSFSaleRepositories> _logger;
        private readonly IDapper _dapper;
        private readonly ISyncUserRepositories _syncUserRepositories;
        private readonly ISyncOSFCustomerRepositories _syncOSFCustomerRepositories;
        public SyncOSFSaleRepositories(
            MatthewsLiquorDBContext context,
            ILogger<SyncOSFSaleRepositories> logger,
            IDapper dapper,
            IBaseClient client,
            ISyncUserRepositories syncUserRepositories,
            ISyncOSFCustomerRepositories syncOSFCustomerRepositories)
        {
            _client = client;
            _logger = logger;
            _context = context;
            _dapper = dapper;
            _syncUserRepositories = syncUserRepositories;
            _syncOSFCustomerRepositories = syncOSFCustomerRepositories;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="days"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public ErrorHandle GetAllSaleFromOSF(int days)
        {
            var setting = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.Active == true).ToList();

            foreach (var item in setting)
            {
                var jobId = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync(days, item.OSF_Website, item.OSF_Access_Token));
            }

            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                Message = $"GetAllSaleFromOSF in {days} days success"
            };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="id"></param>
        /// <param name="vendor"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public async Task<ErrorHandle> GetSaleFromOSF(string id, string vendor)
        {
            var setting = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.Active == true).ToList();

            foreach (var item in setting)
            {
                await GetSaleFormOSFDomainAsync(id, item.OSF_Website);
            }

            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                Message = $"GetAllSaleFromOSF in {id} days success"
            };
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> InsertOrUpdateSale(SaleResponseModel saleResponse, string vendor)
        {
            try
            {
                var sale = _context.SaleOrder.Where(o => o.SaleOrderId == saleResponse.Id && o.SubDomain == vendor).FirstOrDefault();
                var saleOrder = new SaleOrder(saleResponse, vendor);

                if (sale == null)
                {
                    _context.SaleOrder.Add(saleOrder);
                }
                else
                {
                    string delelteItemSaleOrderQueryStr = $@"DELETE FROM ItemSaleOrder WHERE SaleOrderId = '{saleResponse.Id}'";
                    var result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(delelteItemSaleOrderQueryStr, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));
                    string deleltePayemtQueryStr = $@"DELETE FROM Payment WHERE SaleOrderId = '{saleResponse.Id}'";
                    result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(deleltePayemtQueryStr, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

                    sale.RegisterId = saleOrder.RegisterId;
                    sale.RegisterName = saleOrder.RegisterName;
                    sale.OutletId = saleOrder.OutletId;
                    sale.OutletName = saleOrder.OutletName;
                    sale.CustomerId = saleOrder.CustomerId;
                    sale.CustomerName = saleOrder.CustomerName;
                    sale.CustomerPhone = saleOrder.CustomerPhone;
                    sale.ShippingAddress = saleOrder.ShippingAddress;
                    sale.Status = saleOrder.Status;
                    sale.InvoiceId = saleOrder.InvoiceId;
                    sale.Note = saleOrder.Note;
                    sale.InternalNote = saleOrder.InternalNote;
                    sale.OrderReference = saleOrder.OrderReference;
                    sale.TotalPrice = saleOrder.TotalPrice;
                    sale.TotalBase = saleOrder.TotalBase;
                    sale.TotalSaving = saleOrder.TotalSaving;
                    sale.TotalDiscount = saleOrder.TotalDiscount;
                    sale.TotalTax = saleOrder.TotalTax;
                    sale.Savings = saleOrder.Savings;
                    sale.TotalRounding = saleOrder.TotalRounding;
                    sale.TotalChange = saleOrder.TotalChange;
                    sale.LoyaltyValue = saleOrder.LoyaltyValue;
                    sale.Discount = saleOrder.Discount;
                    sale.SubDomain = saleOrder.SubDomain;
                    sale.CreatedAt = saleOrder.CreatedAt;
                    sale.OnshopUpdate = saleOrder.OnshopUpdate;
                    sale.UserId = saleOrder.UserId;
                    sale.ClientId = saleOrder.ClientId;
                    sale.RefId = saleOrder.RefId;
                    if (sale.EpointsId == null || (sale.EpointsId != null && sale.EpointsId.Contains("error")))
                    {
                        sale.EpointsId = saleOrder.EpointsId;
                    }
                }
                _context.SaveChanges();

                _ = InsertOrUpdateItemSaleOrders(saleResponse);

                _ = InsertOrUpdatePayments(saleResponse);

                if (saleResponse.User != null)
                {
                    await _syncUserRepositories.InsertOrUpdateUser(saleResponse.User, vendor);
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "InsertOrUpdateSale success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateSale Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        private ErrorHandle InsertOrUpdatePayments(SaleResponseModel saleResponse)
        {
            try
            {
                foreach (var item in saleResponse.Payments)
                {
                    InsertOrUpdatePayment(item, saleResponse.Id);
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "InsertOrUpdatePayments success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateSale Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        private int InsertOrUpdatePayment(PaymentResponseModel item, string saleOrderId)
        {
            var paymentDB = _context.Payment.Where(o => o.Id == item.Id).FirstOrDefault();

            var payment = new Payment(item, saleOrderId);

            if (paymentDB == null)
            {
                _context.Payment.Add(payment);
            }
            else
            {
                paymentDB.PaymentMethodId = payment.PaymentMethodId;
                paymentDB.PaymentMethodName = payment.PaymentMethodName;
                paymentDB.PaymentMethodType = payment.PaymentMethodType;
                paymentDB.Amount = payment.Amount;
                paymentDB.Status = payment.Status;
                paymentDB.SaleOrderId = payment.SaleOrderId;
                paymentDB.ProcessTime = payment.ProcessTime;
            }
            var result = _context.SaveChanges();

            return result;
        }

        private ErrorHandle InsertOrUpdateItemSaleOrders(SaleResponseModel saleResponse)
        {
            try
            {
                foreach (var item in saleResponse.Items)
                {
                    InsertOrUpdateItemSaleOrder(item, saleResponse.Id);
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "InsertOrUpdateItemSaleOrders success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> GetSaleFormOSFDomainAsync(string id, string domain)
        {
            try
            {
                var salesRequest = new GraphQLRequest
                {
                    Query = OSFResource.saleDetailQuery,
                    OperationName = "getSaleDetail",
                    Variables = new
                    {

                    }
                };

                    domain,
                    salesRequest);

                {

                    await InsertOrUpdateSale(item, domain);

                else
                {

            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation($"GetSaleFormOSFDomainAsync- {domain} - Error - Message: {ex.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = ex.Message
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync(int days, string domain, string accessToken)
        {
            try
            {
                var endPageCursor = "";
                var hasNextItem = false;
                do
                {
                    DateTime currentDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-1 * days);
                    var salesRequest = new GraphQLRequest
                    {
                        Query = OSFResource.saleQuery,
                        OperationName = "getSales",
                        Variables = new
                        {
                            after = string.IsNullOrEmpty(endPageCursor) ? "" : endPageCursor,
                            first = 50,
                            startDate = currentDate
                        }
                    };
                    var productResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(
                        domain,
                        salesRequest);
                    if (productResult != null && productResult.Data != null)
                    {

                        EdgeResponseModel<NodeResponseModel<SaleResponseModel>> productRoot = productResult.GetDataFieldAs<EdgeResponseModel<NodeResponseModel<SaleResponseModel>>>("sales");

                        foreach (var item in productRoot.Edges.Where(x => x != null).Select(x => x.Node))
                        {

                            await InsertOrUpdateSale(item, domain);


                            if (item.UpdatedAt < currentDate.Date)
                            {
                                hasNextItem = false;
                                _logger.LogInformation($"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync - {domain}: END: {item.Id} - {item.UpdatedAt}");
                                return new ErrorHandle()
                                {
                                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                                    Message = $"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync End Item: {item.Id} - {item.UpdatedAt}"
                                };
                            }
                        }
                        hasNextItem = productRoot.PageInfo.HasNextPage;
                        endPageCursor = productRoot.PageInfo.EndCursor;
                        _logger.LogInformation($"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync - {domain} - page : {endPageCursor}");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        hasNextItem = false;
                        _logger.LogError($"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync - {domain}: ERROR: {productResult.Errors[0]}");
                        return new ErrorHandle()
                        {
                            ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                            Message = "GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync Error"
                        };
                    }
                } while (hasNextItem);


                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync Success- {domain} - Page : {endPageCursor}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation($"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync- {domain} - Error - Message: {ex.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = ex.Message
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ReponseHandle<CreateSaleOrderResponseModel>> CreateOSFSaleToSite(CreateOSFSaleOrderRequest requestBody)
        {
            try
            {
                _logger.LogError("ORDER BODY");
                _logger.LogError(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(requestBody));
                if (requestBody.SiteId == 0)
                {
                    requestBody.SiteId = Const.DefaultSiteId;
                }

                var setting = _context.Setting.Where(o => o.SiteId == requestBody.SiteId && o.Active == true).FirstOrDefault();
                if (setting == null)
                {
                    return new ReponseHandle<CreateSaleOrderResponseModel>()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                        Message = $"SiteId = {requestBody.SiteId} không tồn tại",
                        Data = null
                    };
                }
                CreateSaleOrderResponseModel responseModel = null;
                dynamic requestOSFBody = await GetCreateOSFSaleOrderToSiteRequest(requestBody, setting.OSF_Website);
                var createSaleRequest = new GraphQLRequest
                {
                    Query = OSFResource.createSaleQuery,
                    OperationName = "CreateSale",
                    Variables = requestOSFBody
                };
                var productResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(
                    setting.OSF_Website,
                    createSaleRequest);
                if (productResult != null && productResult.Data != null)
                {
                    SaleResponseModel productRoot = productResult.GetDataFieldAs<SaleResponseModel>("createSale");
                    responseModel = new CreateSaleOrderResponseModel(productRoot, setting.SiteId);
                }
                else
                {
                    _logger.LogError($"Tạo đơn hàng thất bại: Order COde - {requestBody.OrderCode} Site: {requestBody.SiteId} Source: {requestBody.OrderSource}");
                    return new ReponseHandle<CreateSaleOrderResponseModel>()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                        Message = $"Tạo đơn hàng thất bại",
                        Data = null
                    };
                }


                return new ReponseHandle<CreateSaleOrderResponseModel>()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"Tạo đơn hàng thất bại",
                    Data = responseModel
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError(e.Message);
            }
            return new ReponseHandle<CreateSaleOrderResponseModel>()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                Message = $"Tạo đơn hàng thất bại",
                Data = null
            };
        }

        public async Task<dynamic> GetCreateOSFSaleOrderToSiteRequest(CreateOSFSaleOrderRequest requestBody, string vendor)
        {
            Register register = _context.Register.Where(x => x.OutletId == requestBody.OutletUuid.Replace("-", "").ToLower()).FirstOrDefault();
            User user = _context.User.Where(x => x.SubDomain == vendor).FirstOrDefault();
            OutletDomain outlet = _context.OutletDomain.Where(x => x.OutletId == requestBody.OutletUuid.Replace("-", "").ToLower()).FirstOrDefault();

            if (register == null)
            {
                throw new Exception("The register is not found.");
            }

            string status = "";
            status = SaleResponseModel.INCOMPLETE_STATUS.ToUpper();

            string customerId = null;
            if (requestBody.CustomerUuid != null && requestBody.CustomerUuid.Trim().Length > 0)
            {
                string customerOSFQuery = $@"
                        SELECT CO.* 
                        FROM Customer C 
                        JOIN CustomerOSF CO on C.Id = CO.CustomerId
                        WHERE 
                        CO.SubDomain = '{vendor}' AND
                        C.CustomerId = '{requestBody.CustomerUuid}'
                ";
                CustomerOSF customerOSF = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Get<CustomerOSF>(customerOSFQuery, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));
                if (customerOSF != null)
                {
                    customerId = customerOSF.OSF_ID;
                }
                else
                {
                    throw new Exception("The customeris not found.");
                }
            }

            var saleRequest = new
            {
                id = requestBody.OrderCode,
                register = register.RegisterId,
                user = user?.Id,
                customer = customerId,
                status = status,
                note = requestBody.OrderNote,
                internalNote = requestBody.OrderCode,
                invoiceId = requestBody.OrderCode,
                discount = new
                {
                    amount = requestBody.Discount,
                    reason = ""
                },
                createdAt = Helper.ToUTC(requestBody.CreatedAt),
                items = await GetSaleOrderItemRequestAsync(requestBody, vendor),
                payments = GetSalePaymentRequest(requestBody, vendor)
            };



            return new
            {
                sale = saleRequest
            };
        }

        public List<dynamic> GetSalePaymentRequest(CreateOSFSaleOrderRequest requestBody, string subdomain)
        {
            List<dynamic> items = new List<dynamic>();
            if (requestBody.Payment != null)
            {
                foreach (CreateOSFPaymentItemRequest item in requestBody.Payment.ReceiptDetail)
                {
                    if (item.ReceiptType == "ACCCHARGE")
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // string paymentMethod = Const.GetOSFPaymentMethod(item.ReceiptType.ToLower());
                        // if (paymentMethod == "")
                        // {
                        //     throw new Exception("The payment method is not found.");
                        // }

                        PaymentMethod method = _context.PaymentMethod.Where(x => x.SubDomain == subdomain && x.Name.ToLower() == item.ReceiptType.ToLower()).FirstOrDefault();
                        if (method == null)
                        {
                            throw new Exception("The payment method is not found.");
                        }
                        items.Add(new
                        {
                            method = method.Id,
                            amount = item.Amount,
                            processTime = Helper.ToUTC(item.ProcessTime)
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
            if (requestBody.DiscountMember > 0)
            {
                items.Add(new
                {
                    method = "loyalty",
                    amount = requestBody.DiscountMember,
                    processTime = DateTime.UtcNow
                });
            }
            return items;

        }

        public async Task<List<dynamic>> GetSaleOrderItemRequestAsync(CreateOSFSaleOrderRequest requestBody, string vendor)
        {
            List<dynamic> items = new List<dynamic>();
            if (requestBody.OrderDetail == null || requestBody.OrderDetail.Count == 0)
            {
                throw new Exception("The order's products are required.");
            }

            foreach (CreateOSFSaleOrderItemRequest item in requestBody.OrderDetail)
            {
                string productId = item.ObjectCode;
                int sizeQuantity = 1;
                if (item.ObjectCode.Contains("|"))
                {
                    string[] objCodes = item.ObjectCode.Split("|");
                    productId = objCodes[0];
                    string packStr = objCodes[1];
                    sizeQuantity = int.Parse(packStr);
                }

                string productQuery = $@"
                    SELECT P1.* FROM Product AS P
                    JOIN ProductOSF AS P1 ON P.OSF_ID = P1.ProductMasterId
                    WHERE P.EpointsId = '{productId}' 
				    AND P1.Status = 'ACTIVE'
                    AND P1.OSF_Vendor = '{vendor}'
                ";

                ProductOSF product = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Get<ProductOSF>(productQuery, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

                if (product == null)
                {
                    throw new Exception("The product is not found.");
                }

                items.Add(new
                {
                    total = item.Amount,
                    product = new
                    {
                        id = product.OSF_ID,
                        quantity = item.Quantity * sizeQuantity
                    }
                });
            }

            return items;
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> InsertOrUpdateSaleOrder(SaleOrder saleOrder)
        {
            try
            {
                var sale = _context.SaleOrder.Where(o => o.SaleOrderId == saleOrder.SaleOrderId && o.SubDomain == saleOrder.SubDomain).FirstOrDefault();

                if (sale == null)
                {
                    _context.SaleOrder.Add(saleOrder);
                }
                else
                {
                    string delelteItemSaleOrderQueryStr = $@"DELETE FROM ItemSaleOrder WHERE SaleOrderId = '{saleOrder.SaleOrderId}'";
                    var result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(delelteItemSaleOrderQueryStr, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));
                    string deleltePayemtQueryStr = $@"DELETE FROM Payment WHERE SaleOrderId = '{saleOrder.SaleOrderId}'";
                    result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(deleltePayemtQueryStr, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

                    sale.RegisterId = saleOrder.RegisterId;
                    sale.RegisterName = saleOrder.RegisterName;
                    sale.OutletId = saleOrder.OutletId;
                    sale.OutletName = saleOrder.OutletName;
                    sale.CustomerId = saleOrder.CustomerId;
                    sale.CustomerName = saleOrder.CustomerName;
                    sale.CustomerPhone = saleOrder.CustomerPhone;
                    sale.ShippingAddress = saleOrder.ShippingAddress;
                    sale.Status = saleOrder.Status;
                    sale.InvoiceId = saleOrder.InvoiceId;
                    sale.Note = saleOrder.Note;
                    sale.InternalNote = saleOrder.InternalNote;
                    sale.OrderReference = saleOrder.OrderReference;
                    sale.TotalPrice = saleOrder.TotalPrice;
                    sale.TotalBase = saleOrder.TotalBase;
                    sale.TotalSaving = saleOrder.TotalSaving;
                    sale.TotalDiscount = saleOrder.TotalDiscount;
                    sale.TotalTax = saleOrder.TotalTax;
                    sale.Savings = saleOrder.Savings;
                    sale.TotalRounding = saleOrder.TotalRounding;
                    sale.TotalChange = saleOrder.TotalChange;
                    sale.LoyaltyValue = saleOrder.LoyaltyValue;
                    sale.Discount = saleOrder.Discount;
                    sale.SubDomain = saleOrder.SubDomain;
                    sale.CreatedAt = saleOrder.CreatedAt;
                    sale.UserId = saleOrder.UserId;
                    sale.RefId = saleOrder.RefId;
                    sale.RegisterId = saleOrder.RegisterId;
                    sale.RegisterName = saleOrder.RegisterName;
                    if (sale.EpointsId == null || (sale.EpointsId != null && sale.EpointsId.Contains("error")))
                    {
                        sale.EpointsId = saleOrder.EpointsId;
                    }
                }
                _context.SaveChanges();

                //await InsertOrUpdateItemSaleOrders(saleResponse);

                //await InsertOrUpdatePayments(saleResponse);

                //if (saleResponse.User != null)
                //{
                //    await _syncUserRepositories.InsertOrUpdateUser(saleResponse.User, vendor);
                //}

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "InsertOrUpdateSale success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateSale Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public ErrorHandle InsertOrUpdateItemSaleOrder(List<BeposTransactionProductModel> lines)
        {
            try
            {
                string saleOrderId = "";
                double totalDiscountMember = 0;
                foreach (var item in lines)
                {
                    var itemSale = new ItemSaleOrder(item);
                    saleOrderId = item.TransactionID.ToString();
                    totalDiscountMember += itemSale.DiscountMember ?? 0;

                    _context.ItemSaleOrder.Add(itemSale);
                }
                if (saleOrderId != "")
                {
                    UpdateDiscountMemberSaleOrder(saleOrderId, totalDiscountMember);
                }
                var result = _context.SaveChanges();
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "InsertOrUpdateItemSaleOrders success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateItemSaleOrders Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public ErrorHandle UpdateDiscountMemberSaleOrder(string saleOrderId, double totalDiscountMember)
        {
            try
            {
                SaleOrder sale = _context.SaleOrder.Where(x => x.SaleOrderId == saleOrderId).FirstOrDefault();

                if (sale != null)
                {
                    sale.TotalSaving = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(totalDiscountMember);
                    sale.Savings = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(totalDiscountMember);
                }

                var result = _context.SaveChanges();
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "InsertOrUpdateItemSaleOrders success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateItemSaleOrders Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public ErrorHandle InsertOrUpdatePaymentSaleOrder(List<BeposTransactionPayment> lines)
        {
            try
            {
                List<PaymentMethod> paymentMethods = _context.PaymentMethod.ToList();

                foreach (var item in lines)
                {
                    var paymentMethod = paymentMethods.Where(x => x.Id == item.PaymentType.ToString()).FirstOrDefault();
                    var payment = new Payment(item, paymentMethod);

                    _context.Payment.Add(payment);
                }
                var result = _context.SaveChanges();
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "InsertOrUpdateItemSaleOrders success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateItemSaleOrders Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> InsertOrUpdateCustomerPayment(CustomerPaymentResponseModel customerPayment, string vendor)
        {
            try
            {
                var customerPaymentDB = _context.CustomerPayment.Where(o => o.Id == customerPayment.Id).FirstOrDefault();
                if(customerPaymentDB == null){
                    customerPaymentDB = new CustomerPayment(customerPayment, vendor);
                    _context.CustomerPayment.Add(customerPaymentDB);    
                    _context.SaveChanges();
                }

                await _syncOSFCustomerRepositories.GetCustomerFormOSFDomain(customerPayment.Customer.Id, vendor);
                foreach (var item in customerPayment.Payments)
                {
                    if(item.Sale != null){
                        await GetSaleFormOSFDomainAsync(item.Sale.Id, vendor);
                    }
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "InsertOrUpdateCustomerPayment success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateCustomerPayment Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> GetSaleData(string vendor)
        {
            var setting = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.OSF_Website == vendor).ToList();
            if(setting == null)
            {
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"GetSaleData Vendor is not found"
                };
            }
            try
            {
                var endPageCursor = "";
                var hasNextItem = false;
                do
                {
                    var salesRequest = new GraphQLRequest
                    {
                        Query = OSFResource.saleDataQuery,
                        OperationName = "getSales",
                        Variables = new
                        {
                            after = string.IsNullOrEmpty(endPageCursor) ? "" : endPageCursor,
                            first = 1000,
                        }
                    };
                    var productResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(
                        vendor,
                        salesRequest);
                    if (productResult != null && productResult.Data != null)
                    {

                        EdgeResponseModel<NodeResponseModel<SaleResponseModel>> productRoot = productResult.GetDataFieldAs<EdgeResponseModel<NodeResponseModel<SaleResponseModel>>>("sales");
                        BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => UpdateSaleData(productRoot.Edges));
                        hasNextItem = productRoot.PageInfo.HasNextPage;
                        endPageCursor = productRoot.PageInfo.EndCursor;
                        _logger.LogInformation($"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync - {vendor} - page : {endPageCursor}");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        hasNextItem = false;
                        _logger.LogError($"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync - {vendor}: ERROR: {productResult.Errors[0]}");
                        return new ErrorHandle()
                        {
                            ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                            Message = "GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync Error"
                        };
                    }
                } while (hasNextItem);


                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync Success- {vendor} - Page : {endPageCursor}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation($"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync- {vendor} - Error - Message: {ex.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = ex.Message
                };
            }
        }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"GetSaleData Error"
                };
            }

        }
    }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> UpdateSaleData(List<NodeResponseModel<SaleResponseModel>> edges)
        {
            try
            {
                foreach (var item in edges.Where(x => x != null).Select(x => x.Node))
                {
                    string updateQuery = $@"UPDATE SaleOrder SET CreatedAt = '{item.CreatedAt.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")}', OnshopUpdate = '{item.UpdatedAt.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")}' WHERE SaleOrderId = '{item.Id}'";
                    var result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(updateQuery, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"GetSaleData Success"
                };
            }catch(Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex.Message);
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"GetSaleData Error"
                };
            }

        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle<CustomerPaymentResponseModel>> GetCustomerPaymentFromOSF(string id, string vendor)
        {
            try
            {
                var customerPaymentRequest = new GraphQLRequest
                {
                    Query = OSFResource.customerPaymentDetailQuery,
                    OperationName = "getCustomerPayment",
                    Variables = new
                    {
                        id = id
                    }
                };
                var result = await _client.CallApiGraphql(vendor, customerPaymentRequest);
                if (result != null && result.Data != null)
                {
                    CustomerPaymentResponseModel customerPayment = result.GetDataFieldAs<CustomerPaymentResponseModel>("customerPayment");
                    return new ErrorHandle<CustomerPaymentResponseModel>()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                        Message = "GetCustomerPaymentFromOSF success",
                        Data = customerPayment
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    string errorMessage = result?.Errors != null && result.Errors.Length > 0
                        ? result.Errors[0].Message
                        : "Unknown error";
                    _logger.LogError($"GetCustomerPaymentFromOSF - {vendor}: ERROR: {errorMessage}");
                    return new ErrorHandle<CustomerPaymentResponseModel>()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                        Message = $"GetCustomerPaymentFromOSF Error: {errorMessage}",
                        Data = null
                    };
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"GetCustomerPaymentFromOSF - {vendor} - Error - Message: {ex.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle<CustomerPaymentResponseModel>()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"GetCustomerPaymentFromOSF Error: {ex.Message}",
                    Data = null
                };
            }
        }
    }
}

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> HandleCustomerPaymentEvent(CustomerPaymentResponseModel customerPayment, string vendor)
        {
            try
            {
                var result = await _syncOSFSaleRepositories.InsertOrUpdateCustomerPayment(customerPayment, vendor);
                if (result.ErrorCode == Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success)
                {
                    foreach (var item in customerPayment.Payments)
                    {
                        if (item.Sale != null)
                        {
                            await _syncEpointsSaleOrderRepositories.CreateOrUpdatesaleOrderToEpoints(item.Sale, vendor);
                        }
                    }
                }
                return result;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"HandleCustomerPaymentEvent - {ex.Message}");
            }
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                Message = $"HandleCusomerCreatedEvent thất bại"
            };
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> HandleThinCustomerPaidEvent(string customerPaymentId, string vendor)
        {
            try
            {
                // Fetch full customer payment details from OSF API
                var fetchResult = await _syncOSFSaleRepositories.GetCustomerPaymentFromOSF(customerPaymentId, vendor);
                if (fetchResult.ErrorCode != Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success || fetchResult.Data == null)
                {
                    _logger.LogError($"HandleThinCustomerPaidEvent - Failed to fetch customer payment {customerPaymentId} from {vendor}");
                    return new ErrorHandle()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                        Message = $"HandleThinCustomerPaidEvent - Failed to fetch customer payment: {fetchResult.Message}"
                    };
                }

                // Process the customer payment using existing handler
                var result = await HandleCustomerPaymentEvent(fetchResult.Data, vendor);
                return result;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"HandleThinCustomerPaidEvent - {ex.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"HandleThinCustomerPaidEvent thất bại: {ex.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

namespace MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Dtos.EF.Entities
{
    public partial class Payment
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public string PaymentMethodId { get; set; }
        public string PaymentMethodName { get; set; }
        public string PaymentMethodType { get; set; }
        public double? Amount { get; set; }
        public string Status { get; set; }
        public string SaleOrderId { get; set; }
        public DateTime ProcessTime { get; set; }


        public Payment(PaymentResponseModel item, string saleOrderId)
        {
            this.PaymentMethodId = item.PaymentMethod.Id;
            this.PaymentMethodName = item.PaymentMethod.Name;
            this.PaymentMethodType = item.PaymentMethod.Type;
            this.Amount = item.Amount;
            this.Status = item.Status;
            this.SaleOrderId = saleOrderId;
            this.ProcessTime = item.ProcessTime;
        }

        public Payment()
        {
        }

        public Payment(BeposTransactionPayment item, PaymentMethod paymentMethod)
        {
            this.PaymentMethodId = item.PaymentType.ToString();
            this.PaymentMethodName = paymentMethod.Name;
            this.PaymentMethodType = item.PaymentType.ToString();
            this.Amount = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.Amount);
            this.Status = "COMPLETED";
            this.SaleOrderId = item.TransactionID.ToString();
            this.ProcessTime = (DateTime)item.DateTimeAdded;
        }

    }
}

        private int InsertOrUpdatePayment(PaymentResponseModel item, string saleOrderId)
        {
            var paymentDB = _context.Payment.Where(o => o.Id == item.Id).FirstOrDefault();

            var payment = new Payment(item, saleOrderId);

            if (paymentDB == null)
            {
                _context.Payment.Add(payment);
            }
            else
            {
                paymentDB.PaymentMethodId = payment.PaymentMethodId;
                paymentDB.PaymentMethodName = payment.PaymentMethodName;
                paymentDB.PaymentMethodType = payment.PaymentMethodType;
                paymentDB.Amount = payment.Amount;
                paymentDB.Status = payment.Status;
                paymentDB.SaleOrderId = payment.SaleOrderId;
                paymentDB.ProcessTime = payment.ProcessTime;
            }
            var result = _context.SaveChanges();

            return result;
        }

using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Cronjob.Repositories;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos;
using SyncData.Services;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Cronjob.Controllers
{
    [Area("cronjob")]
    [Route("cronjob/v2")]

    public class CronjobController : Controller
    {
        private readonly IOptions<AppSettings> _appSettings;
        private readonly ICronjobRepositories _cronjobRepositories;
        public CronjobController(IOptions<AppSettings> appSettings, ICronjobRepositories cronjobRepositories)
        {

            _appSettings = appSettings;
            _cronjobRepositories = cronjobRepositories;
        }

        [HttpGet("outlet-osf-all")]
        public ErrorHandle GetOutlets()
        {
            return _cronjobRepositories.GetOutletFromOSF();
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-product-to-epoints")]
        public ErrorHandle SyncProductToEpoints()
        {

            return _cronjobRepositories.SyncProductToEpoints();
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-product-to-epoint")]
        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncProductToEpoints(string id)
        {

            return await _cronjobRepositories.SyncProductToEpoints(id);
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-sale-order-to-epoint")]
        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncSaleOrderToEpoints(string orderId)
        {

            return await _cronjobRepositories.SyncSaleOrderToEpoint(orderId);
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-sale-order-to-epoints")]
        public ErrorHandle SyncSaleOrderToEpoints()
        {

            return _cronjobRepositories.SyncSaleOrderToEpoints();
        }

        [HttpGet("promotion-osf-all")]
        public ErrorHandle GetAllPromotionOsf(int days = 30)
        {

            return _cronjobRepositories.GetAllPromotionFromOSF(days);
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-promotion-to-epoints")]
        public ErrorHandle SyncPromotionToEpoints()
        {

            return _cronjobRepositories.SyncPromotionToEpoints();
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-promotion-to-epoint")]
        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncPromotionToEpoint(string id)
        {

            return await _cronjobRepositories.SyncPromotionToEpoint(id);
        }

        [HttpGet("register-osf-all")]
        public ErrorHandle GetAllRegisterOsf()
        {

            return _cronjobRepositories.GetAllRegisterOsf();
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-outlet-to-epoints")]
        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncOutletToEpoints()
        {

            return await _cronjobRepositories.SyncOutletToEpoints();
        }

        [HttpGet("update-inventory-to-epoints")]
        public async Task<ErrorHandle> UpdateInventoryToEpoints(string id, string name)
        {

            return await _cronjobRepositories.UpdateInventoryToEpoints(id, name);
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-parent-category-to-epoints")]
        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncParentCategoryToEpoints()
        {

            return await _cronjobRepositories.SyncParentCategoryToEpoints();
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-product-image-to-epoints")]
        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncProductImageToEpoints()
        {

            return await _cronjobRepositories.SyncProductImageToEpoints();
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-customer-to-epoints")]
        public ErrorHandle SyncCustomerToEpoints()
        {

            return _cronjobRepositories.SyncCustomerToEpoints();
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-customer-to-epoints/{customerId}")]
        public ErrorHandle SyncCustomerToEpoints(string customerId)
        {

            return _cronjobRepositories.SyncACustomerToEpoint(customerId);
        }
    }
}
