using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using GraphQL.Common.Request;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Dtos.EF;
using MatthewsLiquor.Resources;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.EF;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.EF.Entities;
using SyncData.Areas.Sync.Models;
using SyncData.Network;
using SyncData.Resources;
using SyncData.Services;

namespace MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncOutlet
{
    public class SyncOutletRepositories : ISyncOutletRepositories
    {
        private readonly ILogger<SyncOutletRepositories> _logger;
        private readonly IBaseClient _client;
        private readonly IOptions<AppSettings> _appSettings;
        private readonly MatthewsLiquorDBContext _context;
        private readonly IConfiguration _config;
        private readonly IDapper _dapper;
        public SyncOutletRepositories(ILogger<SyncOutletRepositories> logger,
            IBaseClient client,
            IOptions<AppSettings> appSettings,
            MatthewsLiquorDBContext context,
            IConfiguration config,
            IDapper dapper)
        {
            _logger = logger;
            _client = client;
            _appSettings = appSettings;
            _context = context;
            _config = config;
            _dapper = dapper;
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> GetOutletOSFSite(string subDomain, string accessToken)
        {
            try
            {
                var request = new GraphQLRequest
                {
                    Query = OSFResource.outletQuery,
                    OperationName = "outlets"
                };
                var outletResults = await _client.CallApiGraphql(
                    subDomain,
                    request);
                if (outletResults != null && outletResults.Data != null)
                {

                    List<OutletResponseModel> productRoot = outletResults.GetDataFieldAs<List<OutletResponseModel>>("outlets");

                    foreach (var item in productRoot)
                    {

                        _ = InsertOrUpdateOutlet(item, subDomain);
                    }
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync Success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation($"GetOutletOSFSite- {subDomain} - Error - Message: {ex.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = ex.Message
                };
            }
        }

        public ErrorHandle InsertOrUpdateOutlet(OutletResponseModel item, string subDomain)
        {
            try
            {
                var outlet = _context.OutletDomain.Where(o => o.OutletId == item.Id && o.SubDomain == subDomain).FirstOrDefault();
                if (outlet != null)
                {
                    outlet.OutletId = item.Id;
                    outlet.Name = item.Name;
                    outlet.SubDomain = subDomain;

                }
                else
                {
                    OutletDomain outletDomain = new OutletDomain(item, subDomain);
                    _context.OutletDomain.Add(outletDomain);
                }
                var result = _context.SaveChanges();
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateRegister thành công"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateRegister thất bại: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public ErrorHandle InsertOrUpdateOutlet(OutletDomain item)
        {
            try
            {
                var outlet = _context.OutletDomain.Where(o => o.OutletId == item.OutletId && o.SourceCode == item.SourceCode && o.SubDomain == item.SubDomain).FirstOrDefault();
                if (outlet != null)
                {
                    outlet.OutletId = item.OutletId;
                    outlet.Name = item.Name;
                    outlet.SubDomain = item.SubDomain;
                    outlet.SourceCode = item.SourceCode;
                    outlet.StoreViewCode = item.StoreViewCode;

                }
                else
                {
                    _context.OutletDomain.Add(item);
                }
                var result = _context.SaveChanges();
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateRegister thành công"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateRegister thất bại: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public Supplier InsertOrUpdateSupplier(Supplier obj)
        {
            try
            {
                var suplier = _context.Supplier.Where(o => o.SupplierID == obj.SupplierID).FirstOrDefault();

                if (suplier != null)
                {
                    suplier.Name = obj.Name;
                    suplier.Address = obj.Address;
                    suplier.Phone = obj.Phone;
                    suplier.Email = obj.Phone;
                    suplier.UpdatedAt = obj.UpdatedAt;
                    suplier.IsActive = obj.IsActive;

                }
                else
                {
                    _context.Supplier.Add(obj);
                    suplier = obj;
                }
                _context.SaveChanges();
                return suplier;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"Tạo Supplier thật bại: result {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
        }
    }
}

using System.Threading.Tasks;

using SyncData.Areas.Sync.Repositories.OSF.SyncProduct;
using SyncData.Resources;

namespace SyncData.Areas.Sync.Controllers.OSF
{
    [Area(RouterResource.SYNC_AREA)]
    [Route(RouterResource.OSF_PRODUCT_AREA)]
    public class OSFProductController : Controller
    {
        private readonly ISyncOSFProductRepositories _syncOSFProductRepositories;
        public OSFProductController(ISyncOSFProductRepositories syncOSFProductRepositories)
        {
            _syncOSFProductRepositories = syncOSFProductRepositories;
        }

        [HttpGet("")]
        public ErrorHandle GetProductAllOsf()
        {

            return  _syncOSFProductRepositories.GetAllProductFromOSF();
        }

        [HttpGet("by-date")]
        public ErrorHandle GetProductOsfByDate(int date)
        {

            return _syncOSFProductRepositories.GetProductFromOSFByDate(date);
        }

        [HttpPost("")]
        public ErrorHandle GetProduct(string id, string vendor)
        {
            return _syncOSFProductRepositories.GetProductFromOSF(id, vendor);
        }


        [HttpGet("sync-brand-osf")]
        public ErrorHandle GetProductBrand()
        {

           return  _syncOSFProductRepositories.GetProductBrands();
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-family-osf")]
        public ErrorHandle GetProductFamily()
        {

           return _syncOSFProductRepositories.GetProductFamilies();
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-categoy-osf")]
        public ErrorHandle GetProductCategory()
        {

           return _syncOSFProductRepositories.GetProductCategories();
        }

        [HttpGet("sync-supplier-osf")]
        public ErrorHandle GetSuppliers()
        {

           return _syncOSFProductRepositories.GetSuppliers();
        }

    }
}

            }

            return new ErrorHandle()

                Message = "UpdateOdooProductSaleIds Success"
            };
        }

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Bepos.Models;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.Bepos.Entities;
using SyncData.Areas.Sync.Models;

namespace SyncData.Areas.Dtos.EF.Entities
{
    [Table("OutletDomain")]
    public class OutletDomain
    {

        public int Id { get; set; }
        public string OutletId { get; set; }
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public string SubDomain { get; set; }
        public string OdooId { get; set; }
        public string SourceCode { get; set; }
        public string StoreViewCode { get; set; }
        public string OperatorId { get; set; }
        public string TransactionType { get; set; }
        public string TillId { get; set; }
        public int IsActive { get; set; }
        public string PriceSetId { get; set; }
        public bool OnAccount { get; set; }

        [NotMapped]
        public string OutletIdFrom { get; set; }
        [NotMapped]
        public string SubDomainFrom { get; set; }
        [NotMapped]
        public string OutletIdTo { get; set; }
        [NotMapped]
        public string SubDomainTo { get; set; }
        [NotMapped]
        public string MainDomain { get; set; }
        [NotMapped]
        public string TransfereeId { get; set; }


        public OutletDomain()
        {
        }

        public OutletDomain(OutletResponseModel item, string subDomain)
        {
            this.SubDomain = subDomain;
            this.OutletId = item.Id;
            this.Name = item.Name;
        }

        public OutletDomain(BeposVenueStoreModel item)
        {
            OutletId = item.VenueID.ToString();
            Name = item.VenueName;
            SubDomain = "bepos";
            OdooId = "";
            SourceCode = item.StoreID.ToString();
            StoreViewCode = item.StoreID.ToString();
            TillId = item.WorkstationID.ToString();

            // default
            OperatorId = "1017";
            TransactionType = "1040";
        }

        public OutletDomain(OutletDomain item, OutletDomainMaping map)
        {
            OutletId = item.OutletId;
            Name = item.Name;
            SubDomain = item.SubDomain;
            OdooId = item.OdooId;
            SourceCode = item.SourceCode;
            StoreViewCode = item.StoreViewCode;
            TillId = item.TillId;

            // default
            OperatorId = item.OperatorId;
            TransactionType = item.TransactionType;

            OutletIdFrom = map.OutletIdFrom;
            SubDomainFrom = map.SubDomainFrom;
            OutletIdTo = map.OutletIdTo;
            SubDomainTo = map.SubDomainTo;
            MainDomain = map.MainDomain;
            TransfereeId = map.TransfereeId;
        }
    }
}

        /// <summary>

        /// </summary>
        public Startup(IWebHostEnvironment env)
        {
            EnvPath = env.ContentRootPath;
            var builder = new ConfigurationBuilder()
                .SetBasePath(env.ContentRootPath)
                .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json", optional: false, reloadOnChange: true)
                .AddJsonFile($"appsettings.{env.EnvironmentName}.json", optional: true)
                .AddEnvironmentVariables();
            Configuration = builder.Build();
        }

        public void ConfigureServices(IServiceCollection services)
        {
            //services.AddControllersWithViews().AddNewtonsoftJson();

            services.AddRouting(options => options.LowercaseUrls = true);

                //.AddNewtonsoftJson(options =>
                //{
                //    options.SerializerSettings.ContractResolver = new DefaultContractResolver();
                //})
                .AddJsonOptions(
                options =>
                {
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.PropertyNamingPolicy = null;
                    options.JsonSerializerOptions.WriteIndented = true;
                    //options.JsonSerializerOptions.PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true;
                });
            #endregion
            services.Configure<AppSettings>(Configuration.GetSection("AppSettings"));
            services.AddTransient<IDapper, Dapperr>();
            services.AddTransient<IBaseClient, BaseClient>();
            CoreConfigServices(services);
            services.AddOptions();
            BeposConfigServices(services);
            BIConfigServices(services);
            SwaggerConfig(services);
            

            // Add MVC.
            services.AddMvc();

            // Configure session.
            services.AddMemoryCache();
            services.AddDistributedMemoryCache();
            services.AddSession(options => {
                options.IdleTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10);
                options.Cookie =  new CookieBuilder() { Name = ".AuthCodeFlowTutorial.Session" };
            });
        }

        public void SwaggerConfig(IServiceCollection services)
        {
            services.AddSwaggerGen(options =>
            {
                options.SwaggerDoc("v1", new OpenApiInfo { Title = "Ez4shop API Document", Version = "v1" });
                options.AddSecurityDefinition("bearerAuth", new OpenApiSecurityScheme
                {
                    Description = "JWT containing userid claim",
                    Name = "Authorization",
                    In = ParameterLocation.Header,
                    Type = SecuritySchemeType.Http,
                    Scheme = "bearer",
                    BearerFormat = "JWT"
                });
            });
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Configures the HTTP request pipeline.
        /// </summary>
        // This method gets called by the runtime. Use this method to configure the HTTP request pipeline.
        public void Configure(IApplicationBuilder app,
            IWebHostEnvironment env,
            ILoggerFactory loggerFactory)
        {

            var path = Directory.GetCurrentDirectory();
            loggerFactory.AddFile($"{path}\\Logs\\Log.txt");

            //this.AutofacContainer = app.ApplicationServices.GetAutofacRoot();

            app.UseDeveloperExceptionPage();
            app.UseHangfireDashboard("/hangfire", new DashboardOptions
            {
                IgnoreAntiforgeryToken = true,
                Authorization = new[] { new HangfireAuthFilter() }

            });

            app.UseHttpsRedirection();
            app.UseSwagger();
            app.UseSwaggerUI(c =>
            {
                //c.RoutePrefix = "";
                c.SwaggerEndpoint("/swagger/v1/swagger.json", "Ez4shop API V1");
            });
            app.UseStaticFiles();
            app.UseSession();
            app.UseRouting();

            app.UseAuthorization();

            app.UseEndpoints(endpoints =>
            {
                
                endpoints.MapControllerRoute(
                    name: "MyArea",
                    pattern: "{area:exists}/{controller=Home}/{action=Index}/{id?}");
                endpoints.MapControllerRoute(
                    name: "default",
                    pattern: "{controller=Home}/{action=Index}/{id?}");
            });

        }
    }

        public ErrorHandle GetOutletFromOSF()
        {
            var setting = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.Active == true).ToList();
            foreach (var item in setting)
            {
                BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncOutletRepositories.GetOutletOSFSite(item.OSF_Website, item.OSF_Access_Token));
            }
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                Message = $"GetProductFromOSF Success"
            };
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncParentCategoryToEpoints()
        {
            var rs = "";
            string queryStr = @"
                                    SELECT 
                                    P.ID AS ParentCategoryId
                                    , P.Name AS ParentCategoryName
                                    , P.IsActive AS IsActiveParentCategory 
                                    , S.ID AS SubCategoryId
                                    , S.Name AS SubCategoryName
                                    , S.IsActive AS IsActiveSubParentCategory
                                    , C.ID AS CategoryId
                                    , C.Name AS CategoryName
                                    , C.IsActive AS IsActive
                                    FROM CategoryParent P
                                    JOIN CategorySub AS S ON P.ID = S.ParentId
                                    JOIN Category AS C ON S.ID = C.ParentId";
            var items = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.GetAll<object>(queryStr, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));
            BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => _syncEpointsParentCategoryRepositories.SyncParentCategoryToEpointsAsync(items));
            if (rs == "")
            {
                rs = "Nothing to sync";
            }
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                Message = rs
            };
        }

        public Supplier InsertOrUpdateSupplier(Supplier obj)
        {
            try
            {
                var suplier = _context.Supplier.Where(o => o.SupplierID == obj.SupplierID).FirstOrDefault();

                if (suplier != null)
                {
                    suplier.Name = obj.Name;
                    suplier.Address = obj.Address;
                    suplier.Phone = obj.Phone;
                    suplier.Email = obj.Phone;
                    suplier.UpdatedAt = obj.UpdatedAt;
                    suplier.IsActive = obj.IsActive;

                }
                else
                {
                    _context.Supplier.Add(obj);
                    suplier = obj;
                }
                _context.SaveChanges();
                return suplier;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"Tạo Supplier thật bại: result {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
        }

        public ErrorHandle GetAllOutlets()
        {
            try
            {
                var outlets = _context.OutletDomain.ToList();
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "GetAllOutlets Success",
                    Data = outlets
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"GetAllOutlets Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"GetAllOutlets Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public ErrorHandle GetOutletById(int id)
        {
            try
            {
                var outlet = _context.OutletDomain.Where(o => o.Id == id).FirstOrDefault();
                if (outlet == null)
                {
                    return new ErrorHandle()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                        Message = $"Outlet with Id {id} not found"
                    };
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "GetOutletById Success",
                    Data = outlet
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"GetOutletById Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"GetOutletById Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public ErrorHandle SyncAllOutletsFromOSF()
        {
            try
            {
                var settings = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.Active == true).ToList();
                foreach (var item in settings)
                {
                    _ = GetOutletOSFSite(item.OSF_Website, item.OSF_Access_Token);
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "SyncAllOutletsFromOSF Success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"SyncAllOutletsFromOSF Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"SyncAllOutletsFromOSF Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }
    }

        public ErrorHandle<List<OutletDomain>> GetAllOutlets()
        {
            try
            {
                var outlets = _context.OutletDomain.ToList();
                return new ErrorHandle<List<OutletDomain>>()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "GetAllOutlets Success",
                    Data = outlets
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"GetAllOutlets Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle<List<OutletDomain>>()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"GetAllOutlets Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public ErrorHandle<OutletDomain> GetOutletById(int id)
        {
            try
            {
                var outlet = _context.OutletDomain.Where(o => o.Id == id).FirstOrDefault();
                if (outlet == null)
                {
                    return new ErrorHandle<OutletDomain>()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                        Message = $"Outlet with Id {id} not found"
                    };
                }
                return new ErrorHandle<OutletDomain>()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "GetOutletById Success",
                    Data = outlet
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"GetOutletById Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle<OutletDomain>()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"GetOutletById Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

using System.Collections.Generic;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncOutlet;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.EF.Entities;
using SyncData.Resources;

namespace SyncData.Areas.Sync.Controllers.OSF
{
    [Area(RouterResource.SYNC_AREA)]
    [Route(RouterResource.OSF_OUTLET_AREA)]
    [ApiExplorerSettings(GroupName = "OSFOutlet")]
    public class OSFOutletController : Controller
    {
        private readonly ISyncOutletRepositories _syncOutletRepositories;

        public OSFOutletController(ISyncOutletRepositories syncOutletRepositories)
        {
            _syncOutletRepositories = syncOutletRepositories;
        }

        [HttpGet("")]
        public ErrorHandle<List<OutletDomain>> GetAllOutlets()
        {
            return _syncOutletRepositories.GetAllOutlets();
        }

        [HttpGet("{id}")]
        public ErrorHandle<OutletDomain> GetOutletById(int id)
        {
            return _syncOutletRepositories.GetOutletById(id);
        }

        [HttpGet("sync")]
        public ErrorHandle SyncOutletsFromOSF()
        {
            return _syncOutletRepositories.SyncAllOutletsFromOSF();
        }
    }
}

        public ErrorHandle SyncAllOutletsFromOSF()
        {
            try
            {
                var settings = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.Active == true).ToList();
                foreach (var item in settings)
                {
                    _ = GetOutletOSFSite(item.OSF_Website, item.OSF_Access_Token);
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "SyncAllOutletsFromOSF Success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"SyncAllOutletsFromOSF Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"SyncAllOutletsFromOSF Error: {e.Message}"

        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncOutletFromOSFBySite(string subDomain)
        {
            try
            {
                var setting = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.OSF_Website == subDomain && x.Active == true).FirstOrDefault();
                if (setting == null)
                {
                    return new ErrorHandle()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                        Message = $"Setting for subDomain {subDomain} not found"
                    };
                }
                return await GetOutletOSFSite(setting.OSF_Website, setting.OSF_Access_Token);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"SyncOutletFromOSFBySite Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"SyncOutletFromOSFBySite Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }
    }
}

using System.Threading.Tasks;

using SyncData.Resources;

namespace SyncData.Areas.Sync.Controllers.OSF
{
    [Area(RouterResource.SYNC_AREA)]
    [Route(RouterResource.OSF_OUTLET_AREA)]
    [ApiExplorerSettings(GroupName = "OSFOutlet")]
    public class OSFOutletController : Controller
    {
        private readonly ISyncOutletRepositories _syncOutletRepositories;

        public OSFOutletController(ISyncOutletRepositories syncOutletRepositories)

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncOutletFromOSFBySite(string subDomain)
        {

        }
    }
}

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncOutletFromOSFBySite(string subDomain)
        {
            try
            {
                var setting = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.OSF_Website == subDomain && x.Active == true).FirstOrDefault();
                if (setting == null)
                {
                    return new ErrorHandle()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                        Message = $"Setting for subDomain {subDomain} not found"
                    };
                }
                return await GetOutletOSFSite(setting.OSF_Website, setting.OSF_Access_Token);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"SyncOutletFromOSFBySite Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"SyncOutletFromOSFBySite Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncOutletFromOSFById(string outletId, string subDomain)
        {
            try
            {
                var setting = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.OSF_Website == subDomain && x.Active == true).FirstOrDefault();
                if (setting == null)
                {
                    return new ErrorHandle()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                        Message = $"Setting for subDomain {subDomain} not found"
                    };
                }

                var request = new GraphQLRequest
                {
                    Query = OSFResource.outletByIdQuery,
                    OperationName = "getOutlet",
                    Variables = new { id = outletId }
                };

                var outletResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(subDomain, request);
                if (outletResult != null && outletResult.Data != null)
                {
                    OutletResponseModel outlet = outletResult.GetDataFieldAs<OutletResponseModel>("outlet");
                    if (outlet != null)
                    {
                        InsertOrUpdateOutlet(outlet, subDomain);
                    }
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"SyncOutletFromOSFById Success - OutletId: {outletId}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"SyncOutletFromOSFById Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"SyncOutletFromOSFById Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }
    }
}

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncOutletFromOSFById(string outletId)
        {
            try
            {
                var settings = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.Active == true).ToList();
                foreach (var setting in settings)
                {
                    var request = new GraphQLRequest
                    {
                        Query = OSFResource.outletByIdQuery,
                        OperationName = "getOutlet",
                        Variables = new { id = outletId }
                    };

                    var outletResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(setting.OSF_Website, request);
                    if (outletResult != null && outletResult.Data != null)
                    {
                        OutletResponseModel outlet = outletResult.GetDataFieldAs<OutletResponseModel>("outlet");
                        if (outlet != null)
                        {
                            InsertOrUpdateOutlet(outlet, setting.OSF_Website);
                        }
                    }
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"SyncOutletFromOSFById Success - OutletId: {outletId}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"SyncOutletFromOSFById Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"SyncOutletFromOSFById Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using GraphQL.Common.Request;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Dtos.EF;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Models;
using MatthewsLiquor.Resources;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.EF;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.EF.Entities;
using SyncData.Network;
using SyncData.Resources;
using SyncData.Services;

namespace MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncRegister
{
    public class SyncRegisterRepositories : ISyncRegisterRepositories
    {
        private readonly ILogger<SyncRegisterRepositories> _logger;
        private readonly IBaseClient _client;
        private readonly IOptions<AppSettings> _appSettings;
        private readonly MatthewsLiquorDBContext _context;
        private readonly IConfiguration _config;
        private readonly IDapper _dapper;
        public SyncRegisterRepositories(ILogger<SyncRegisterRepositories> logger,
            IBaseClient client,
            IOptions<AppSettings> appSettings,
            MatthewsLiquorDBContext context,
            IConfiguration config,
            IDapper dapper)
        {
            _logger = logger;
            _client = client;
            _appSettings = appSettings;
            _context = context;
            _config = config;
            _dapper = dapper;
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> GetRegisterOSFSite(string domain)
        {
            try
            {
                var registerRequest = new GraphQLRequest
                {
                    Query = OSFResource.registerQuery,
                    OperationName = "registers"
                };
                var registerResults = await _client.CallApiGraphql(
                    domain,
                    registerRequest);
                if (registerResults != null && registerResults.Data != null)
                {

                    List<RegisterResponseModel> productRoot = registerResults.GetDataFieldAs<List<RegisterResponseModel>>("registers");

                    foreach (var item in productRoot)
                    {

                        await InsertOrUpdateRegister(item, domain);
                    }
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync Success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation($"GetRegisterOSFSite- {domain} - Error - Message: {ex.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = ex.Message
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> InsertOrUpdateRegister(RegisterResponseModel item, string domain)
        {
            try
            {
                var register = _context.Register.Where(o => o.OutletId == item.Outlet.Id).FirstOrDefault();
                if (register != null)
                {
                    register.RegisterName = item.Name;
                    register.OutletId = item.Outlet.Id;
                    register.OutletName = item.Outlet.Name;
                    register.SubDomain = domain;
                    register.OpenTime = item.OpenTime;
                    register.Closed = (bool)item.Closed ? 1 : 0;

                }
                else
                {
                    Register res = new Register(item, domain);
                    _context.Register.Add(res);
                }
                var result = await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                if (result > 0)
                {
                    return new ErrorHandle()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                        Message = $"InsertOrUpdateRegister thành công"
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    _logger.LogError($"InsertOrUpdateRegister thật bại: result {result}");
                    return new ErrorHandle()
                    {
                        ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                        Message = $"InsertOrUpdateRegister thất bại"
                    };
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateRegister thất bại: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }
    }
}

        public ErrorHandle SyncAllRegistersFromOSF()
        {
            try
            {
                var settings = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.Active == true).ToList();
                foreach (var item in settings)
                {
                    _ = GetRegisterOSFSite(item.OSF_Website);
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = "SyncAllRegistersFromOSF Success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"SyncAllRegistersFromOSF Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"SyncAllRegistersFromOSF Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncRegisterFromOSFById(string registerId)
        {
            try
            {
                var settings = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.Active == true).ToList();
                foreach (var setting in settings)
                {
                    var request = new GraphQLRequest
                    {
                        Query = OSFResource.registerByIdQuery,
                        OperationName = "getRegister",
                        Variables = new { id = registerId }
                    };

                    var registerResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(setting.OSF_Website, request);
                    if (registerResult != null && registerResult.Data != null)
                    {
                        RegisterResponseModel register = registerResult.GetDataFieldAs<RegisterResponseModel>("register");
                        if (register != null)
                        {
                            await InsertOrUpdateRegister(register, setting.OSF_Website);
                        }
                    }
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"SyncRegisterFromOSFById Success - RegisterId: {registerId}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"SyncRegisterFromOSFById Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"SyncRegisterFromOSFById Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }
    }
}

using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncRegister;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos;
using SyncData.Resources;

namespace SyncData.Areas.Sync.Controllers.OSF
{
    [Area(RouterResource.SYNC_AREA)]
    [Route(RouterResource.OSF_REGISTER_AREA)]
    [ApiExplorerSettings(GroupName = "OSFRegister")]
    public class OSFRegisterController : Controller
    {
        private readonly ISyncRegisterRepositories _syncRegisterRepositories;

        public OSFRegisterController(ISyncRegisterRepositories syncRegisterRepositories)
        {
            _syncRegisterRepositories = syncRegisterRepositories;
        }

        [HttpGet("")]
        public ErrorHandle SyncAllRegistersFromOSF()
        {
            return _syncRegisterRepositories.SyncAllRegistersFromOSF();
        }

        [HttpGet("{id}")]
        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncRegisterFromOSFById(string id)
        {
            return await _syncRegisterRepositories.SyncRegisterFromOSFById(id);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data;

using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncPromotion
{
    public class SyncPromotionRepositories : ISyncPromotionRepositories
    {
        private readonly MatthewsLiquorDBContext _context;
        private readonly IBaseClient _client;
        private readonly ILogger<SyncPromotionRepositories> _logger;
        private readonly IDapper _dapper;
        public SyncPromotionRepositories(
            MatthewsLiquorDBContext context,
            ILogger<SyncPromotionRepositories> logger,
            IDapper dapper,
            IBaseClient client)
        {
            _client = client;
            _logger = logger;
            _context = context;
            _dapper = dapper;
        }

        public ErrorHandle GetAllPromotionFromOSF(int days)
        {
            var setting = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.Active == true).ToList();

            foreach (var item in setting)
            {
                var jobId = BackgroundJob.Enqueue(() => GetAllPromotionFromOSFAsync(days, item.OSF_Website));
            }

            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                Message = $"GetAllSaleFromOSF in {days} days success"
            };
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> GetAllPromotionFromOSFAsync(int days, string domain)
        {
            try
            {
                var endPageCursor = "";
                var hasNextItem = false;
                var page = 0;
                if (domain == "matthewsliquor")
                {
                    page = 0;
                }
                do
                {
                    DateTime currentDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-1 * days);
                    page += 1;

                    Object[] orderingInput = {
                        new { sort = "updatedAt", direction = "desc" } };
                    var promotionsRequest = new GraphQLRequest
                    {
                        Query = OSFResource.promotionQuery,
                        OperationName = "GetPromotions",
                        Variables = new
                        {
                            after = string.IsNullOrEmpty(endPageCursor) ? "" : endPageCursor,
                            first = 10,
                            ordering = orderingInput
                        }
                    };
                    var productResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(
                        domain,
                        promotionsRequest);
                    if (productResult != null && productResult.Data != null)
                    {

                        EdgeResponseModel<NodeResponseModel<PromotionResponseModel>> productRoot = productResult.GetDataFieldAs<EdgeResponseModel<NodeResponseModel<PromotionResponseModel>>>("promotions");

                        foreach (var item in productRoot.Edges.Where(x => x != null).Select(x => x.Node))
                        {

                            await InsertOrUpdatePromotion(item, domain);


                            if (page >= 10 && item.End < currentDate.Date)
                            {
                                hasNextItem = false;
                                _logger.LogInformation($"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync - {domain}: END: {item.Id} - {item.End}");
                                return new ErrorHandle()
                                {
                                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                                    Message = $"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync End Item: {item.Id} - {item.End}"
                                };
                            }
                        }
                        hasNextItem = productRoot.PageInfo.HasNextPage;
                        endPageCursor = productRoot.PageInfo.EndCursor;
                        _logger.LogInformation($"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync - {domain} - page : {endPageCursor}");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        hasNextItem = false;
                        _logger.LogError($"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync - {domain}: ERROR: {productResult}");
                        return new ErrorHandle()
                        {
                            ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                            Message = "GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync Error"
                        };
                    }
                } while (hasNextItem);


                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"GetAllSaleFormOSFDomainAsync Success- {domain} - Page : {endPageCursor}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation($"GetAllPromotionFromOSFAsync- {domain} - Error - Message: {ex.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = ex.Message
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> InsertOrUpdatePromotion(PromotionResponseModel promotionResponse, string vendor)
        {
            try
            {
                var promotionDB = _context.Promotion.Where(x => x.PromotionId == promotionResponse.Id && x.SubDomain == vendor).FirstOrDefault();

                var promotion = new Promotion(promotionResponse, vendor);

                if (promotionDB == null)
                {
                    _context.Add(promotion);
                }
                else
                {
                    string deleltePromotionCriteriaQueryStr = $@"DELETE FROM PromotionCriteria WHERE PromotionId = '{promotionResponse.Id}'";
                    var result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(deleltePromotionCriteriaQueryStr, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

                    string deleltePromotionCriteriaBrandQueryStr = $@"DELETE FROM PromotionCriteriaBrand WHERE PromotionId = '{promotionResponse.Id}'";
                    result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(deleltePromotionCriteriaBrandQueryStr, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

                    string deleltePromotionCriteriaCategoryQueryStr = $@"DELETE FROM PromotionCriteriaCategory WHERE PromotionId = '{promotionResponse.Id}'";
                    result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(deleltePromotionCriteriaCategoryQueryStr, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

                    string deleltePromotionCriteriaFamilyQueryStr = $@"DELETE FROM PromotionCriteriaFamily WHERE PromotionId = '{promotionResponse.Id}'";
                    result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(deleltePromotionCriteriaFamilyQueryStr, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

                    string deleltePromotionCriteriaProductQueryStr = $@"DELETE FROM PromotionCriteriaProduct WHERE PromotionId = '{promotionResponse.Id}'";
                    result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(deleltePromotionCriteriaProductQueryStr, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

                    string deleltePromotionCriteriaTagQueryStr = $@"DELETE FROM PromotionCriteriaTag WHERE PromotionId = '{promotionResponse.Id}'";
                    result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(deleltePromotionCriteriaTagQueryStr, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

                    string deleltePromotionOutletQueryStr = $@"DELETE FROM PromotionOutlet WHERE PromotionId = '{promotionResponse.Id}'";
                    result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(deleltePromotionOutletQueryStr, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));


                    string deleltePromotionCustomerGroupQueryStr = $@"DELETE FROM PromotionCustomerGroup WHERE PromotionId = '{promotionResponse.Id}'";
                    result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(deleltePromotionCustomerGroupQueryStr, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

                    promotionDB.PromotionCategoryId = promotion.PromotionCategoryId;
                    promotionDB.CustomerGroupId = promotion.CustomerGroupId;
                    promotionDB.MdbSyncing = promotion.MdbSyncing;
                    promotionDB.MdbId = promotion.MdbId;
                    promotionDB.Express = promotion.Express;
                    promotionDB.Active = promotion.Active;
                    promotionDB.Name = promotion.Name;
                    promotionDB.Start = promotion.Start;
                    promotionDB.End = promotion.End;
                    promotionDB.AvailableTo = promotion.AvailableTo;
                    promotionDB.QuantityLimitStart = promotion.QuantityLimitStart;
                    promotionDB.QuantityLimitCurrent = promotion.QuantityLimitCurrent;
                    promotionDB.MixCriteria = promotion.MixCriteria;
                    promotionDB.UpdatedAt = promotion.UpdatedAt;
                    promotionDB.DeletedAt = promotion.DeletedAt;
                    promotionDB.LastSync = promotion.LastSync;
                    promotionDB.SubDomain = promotion.SubDomain;
                }

                _context.SaveChanges();

                _ = InsertPromotionCategory(promotionResponse.PromotionCategory, promotionResponse.Id);
                _ = InsertPromotionCustomerGroup(promotionResponse.CustomerGroups, promotionResponse.Id);
                await InsertPromotionOutlet(promotionResponse.Outlets, promotionResponse.Id);
                _ = InsertPromotionCriteria(promotionResponse.Criteria, promotionResponse.Id);


                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdatePromotion Success- {vendor} - Page : {promotionResponse.Id}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdatePromotion Error - {vendor} - Page : {promotionResponse.Id} - Message: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public ErrorHandle InsertPromotionCriteria(List<PromotionCriteriaResponseModel> criteria, string id)
        {
            try
            {
                if (criteria != null && criteria.Count > 0)
                {
                    foreach (var item in criteria)
                    {
                        PromotionCriteria promotionCriteria = new PromotionCriteria(item, id);
                        _context.PromotionCriteria.Add(promotionCriteria);
                        _context.SaveChanges();

                        foreach (var criteriaItem in item.Items)
                        {
                            if (criteriaItem.Item.TypeName.ToLower() == "product")
                            {
                                PromotionCriteriaProduct criteriaProduct = new PromotionCriteriaProduct(criteriaItem, promotionCriteria.PromotionCriteriaId, id);
                                _context.PromotionCriteriaProduct.Add(criteriaProduct);
                            }
                            else if (criteriaItem.Item.TypeName.ToLower() == "brand")
                            {
                                PromotionCriteriaBrand criteriaBrand = new PromotionCriteriaBrand(criteriaItem, promotionCriteria.PromotionCriteriaId, id);
                                _context.PromotionCriteriaBrand.Add(criteriaBrand);
                            }
                            else if (criteriaItem.Item.TypeName.ToLower() == "category")
                            {

                                PromotionCriteriaCategory criteriaCategory = new PromotionCriteriaCategory(criteriaItem, promotionCriteria.PromotionCriteriaId, id);
                                _context.PromotionCriteriaCategory.Add(criteriaCategory);
                            }
                            else if (criteriaItem.Item.TypeName.ToLower() == "family")
                            {
                                PromotionCriteriaFamily criteriaFamily = new PromotionCriteriaFamily(criteriaItem, promotionCriteria.PromotionCriteriaId, id);
                                _context.PromotionCriteriaFamily.Add(criteriaFamily);
                            }
                            else if (criteriaItem.Item.TypeName.ToLower() == "tag")
                            {
                                PromotionCriteriaTag criteriaTag = new PromotionCriteriaTag(criteriaItem, promotionCriteria.PromotionCriteriaId, id);
                                _context.PromotionCriteriaTag.Add(criteriaTag);
                            }
                            _context.SaveChanges();
                        }
                    }
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"InsertPromotionCriteria Success - {id}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"InsertPromotionCriteria Error - {id}: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertPromotionCriteria Error - {id}: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> InsertPromotionOutlet(List<OutletResponseModel> outlets, string id)
        {
            try
            {
                if (outlets != null && outlets.Count > 0)
                {
                    var promotionOutlets = _context.PromotionOutlet.Where(x => x.PromotionId == id).ToList();
                    foreach (var item in outlets)
                    {
                        var promotionDB = promotionOutlets.Where(x => x.OutletId == item.Id).FirstOrDefault();
                        PromotionOutlet promotionOutlet = new PromotionOutlet(item, id);
                        if (promotionDB == null)
                        {
                            _context.PromotionOutlet.Add(promotionOutlet);
                            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                        }
                    }
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"InsertPromotionCategory Success - {id}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"InsertPromotionCategory Error - {id}: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertPromotionCategory Error - {id}: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public ErrorHandle InsertPromotionCategory(PromotionCategoryResponseModel promotionCategory, string id)

        public ErrorHandle InsertOrUpdatePromotion(Promotion obj)
        {
            try
            {
                var promotionDB = _context.Promotion.Where(x => x.PromotionId == obj.PromotionId && x.SubDomain == obj.SubDomain).FirstOrDefault();
                if (promotionDB == null)
                {
                    _context.Add(obj);
                }
                else
                {
                    promotionDB.PromotionId = obj.PromotionId;
                    promotionDB.Active = obj.Active;
                    promotionDB.Name = obj.Name;
                    promotionDB.PromotionCategoryId = obj.PromotionCategoryId;
                    promotionDB.CustomerGroupId = obj.CustomerGroupId;
                    promotionDB.UpdatedAt = obj.UpdatedAt;
                    promotionDB.LastSync = obj.LastSync;
                    promotionDB.Start = obj.Start;
                    promotionDB.End = obj.End;
                }
                _context.SaveChanges();

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdatePromotion Success- {obj.SubDomain} - PromotionId : {obj.PromotionId}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"InsertOrUpdatePromotion Error PromotionID {obj.PromotionId} - {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdatePromotion Error PromotionID {obj.PromotionId} - {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> InsertOrUpdatePromotionCriteriaAsync(List<PromotionCriteria> criterias)
        {
            string updatePromotionCriteria = "";
            try
            {
                if (criterias != null && criterias.Count > 0)
                {
                    string promotionId = criterias[0].PromotionId;
                    await deletePromotionCriteria(promotionId);
                    string generatePromotionCriteria = GeneratePromotionCriteria(criterias);
                    updatePromotionCriteria = $@"
                    MERGE INTO PromotionCriteria T
                    USING ( VALUES {generatePromotionCriteria}
                    ) AS S ( PromotionCriteriaId, PromotionId, Type, QuantityType, BuyAmount, DiscountAmount, MinQuantity)
                    ON T.PromotionCriteriaId = S.PromotionCriteriaId
                    WHEN MATCHED THEN 
                    UPDATE
                        SET Type = S.Type, QuantityType = S.QuantityType, BuyAmount = S.BuyAmount, DiscountAmount = S.DiscountAmount, MinQuantity = S.MinQuantity
                    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                    INSERT ( PromotionCriteriaId, PromotionId, Type, QuantityType, BuyAmount, DiscountAmount, MinQuantity) 
                    VALUES ( PromotionCriteriaId, PromotionId, Type, QuantityType, BuyAmount, DiscountAmount, MinQuantity);
                ";
                    var resultUpdate = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(updatePromotionCriteria, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

                    _ = InsertOrUpdateCriteriaProduct(criterias);
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateProductPrices success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"InsertOrUpdateProductPrices {e.Message}");
                _logger.LogError($"InsertOrUpdateProductPrices {updatePromotionCriteria}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateProductPrices {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task deletePromotionCriteria(string promotionId)
        {
            string deleteQuery = $@"DELETE FROM PromotionCriteria WHERE PromotionId = '{promotionId}'";
            var result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(deleteQuery, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

        }

        public async Task deletePromotionCriteriaProduct(string promotionId)
        {
            string deleteQuery = $@"DELETE FROM PromotionCriteriaProduct WHERE PromotionId = '{promotionId}'";
            var result = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(deleteQuery, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> InsertOrUpdateCriteriaProduct(List<PromotionCriteria> criterias)
        {
            string updatePromotionCriteriaProduct = "";
            try
            {
                if (criterias != null && criterias.Count > 0)
                {
                    string promotionId = criterias[0].PromotionId;
                    await deletePromotionCriteriaProduct(promotionId);
                    string generatePromotionCriteriaProduct = GeneratePromotionCriteriaProduct(criterias);
                    updatePromotionCriteriaProduct = $@"
                    MERGE INTO PromotionCriteriaProduct T
                    USING ( VALUES {generatePromotionCriteriaProduct}
                    ) AS S (PromotionCriteriaId, ProductID, Rebate, Excluded, CriteriaProductId, PromotionId)
                    ON T.PromotionCriteriaId = S.PromotionCriteriaId AND T.ProductID = S.ProductID
                    WHEN MATCHED THEN 
                    UPDATE
                        SET Rebate = S.Rebate, Excluded = S.Excluded, CriteriaProductId = S.CriteriaProductId, PromotionId = S.PromotionId
                    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
                    INSERT (PromotionCriteriaId, ProductID, Rebate, Excluded, CriteriaProductId, PromotionId) 
                    VALUES (PromotionCriteriaId, ProductID, Rebate, Excluded, CriteriaProductId, PromotionId);
                ";
                    var resultUpdate = await Task.FromResult(_dapper.Execute(updatePromotionCriteriaProduct, null, commandType: CommandType.Text));

                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateProductPrices success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"InsertOrUpdateProductPrices {e.Message}");
                _logger.LogError($"InsertOrUpdateProductPrices {updatePromotionCriteriaProduct}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdateProductPrices {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public string GeneratePromotionCriteriaProduct(List<PromotionCriteria> criterias)
        {
            string values = "";

            foreach (PromotionCriteria criteria in criterias)
            {
                foreach (PromotionCriteriaProduct productCriteria in criteria.CriteriaProducts)
                {
                    int Excluded = productCriteria.Excluded ? 1 : 0;
                    values += $"('{productCriteria.PromotionCriteriaId}', '{productCriteria.ProductId}', {productCriteria.Rebate}, {Excluded}, '{productCriteria.CriteriaProductId}', '{productCriteria.PromotionId}'),";
                }
            }

            return values.Length > 0 ? values.Substring(0, values.Length - 1) : values;
        }

        public string GeneratePromotionCriteria(List<PromotionCriteria> criterias)
        {
            string values = "";

            foreach (PromotionCriteria criteria in criterias)
            {
                values += $"('{criteria.PromotionCriteriaId}', '{criteria.PromotionId}', '{criteria.Type}', '{criteria.QuantityType}', {criteria.BuyAmount}, {criteria.DiscountAmount}, {criteria.MinQuantity}),";
            }

            return values.Length > 0 ? values.Substring(0, values.Length - 1) : values;
        }

        public ErrorHandle InsertOrUpdatePromotionCustomerGroup(PromotionCustomerGroup customerGroup)
        {
            try
            {
                if (customerGroup != null && customerGroup.CustomerGroupId != "" && customerGroup.CustomerGroupId != "0")
                {
                    PromotionCustomerGroup oPromotionCumerGroup = _context.PromotionCustomerGroup.Where(x => x.PromotionId == customerGroup.PromotionId &&
                                                                                                             x.CustomerGroupId == customerGroup.CustomerGroupId).FirstOrDefault();
                    if (oPromotionCumerGroup == null)
                    {
                        _context.PromotionCustomerGroup.Add(customerGroup);
                        _context.SaveChanges();
                    }
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdatePromotionCustomerGroup Success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"InsertOrUpdatePromotionCustomerGroup Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdatePromotionCustomerGroup Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public ErrorHandle InsertOrUpdatePromotionOutlet(PromotionOutlet promotionOutlet)
        {
            try
            {
                if (promotionOutlet != null && promotionOutlet.OutletId != "" && promotionOutlet.OutletId != "0")
                {
                    PromotionOutlet oPromotionOutlet = _context.PromotionOutlet.Where(x => x.PromotionId == promotionOutlet.PromotionId &&
                                                                                                             x.OutletId == promotionOutlet.OutletId).FirstOrDefault();
                    if (oPromotionOutlet == null)
                    {
                        _context.PromotionOutlet.Add(promotionOutlet);
                        _context.SaveChanges();
                    }
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdatePromotionCustomerGroup Success"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"InsertOrUpdatePromotionCustomerGroup Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"InsertOrUpdatePromotionCustomerGroup Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> GetPromotion(string promotionId, string vendor)
        {
            var setting = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.Active == true && x.OSF_Website == vendor).FirstOrDefault();
            if (setting != null)
            {
                await GetPromotionFromOSFDomain(promotionId, vendor);
            }
            return new ErrorHandle()
            {
                ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                Message = $"GetAllProductFromOSF Success"
            };
        }

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> GetPromotionFromOSFDomain(string id, string domain)
        {
            try
            {
                var promotionRequest = new GraphQLRequest
                {
                    Query = OSFResource.promotionDetailQuery,
                    OperationName = "promotion",
                    Variables = new
                    {
                        id = id,
                    }
                };
                var promotionResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(
                    domain,
                    promotionRequest);
                if (promotionResult != null && promotionResult.Data != null)
                {

                    PromotionResponseModel item = promotionResult.GetDataFieldAs<PromotionResponseModel>("promotion");
                    await InsertOrUpdatePromotion(item, domain);
                    _logger.LogInformation($"GetProductFormOSFDomainAsync - {domain} - id : {id}");
                }
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"GetProductFormOSFDomainAsync Success- {domain} - id : {id}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation($"GetProductFormOSFDomainAsync- {domain} - id : {id} - Error - Message: {ex.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = ex.Message
                };
            }
        }
    }
}

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncPromotionFromOSFById(string promotionId)
        {
            try
            {
                var settings = _context.Setting.Where(x => x.Active == true).ToList();
                foreach (var setting in settings)
                {
                    await GetPromotionFromOSFDomain(promotionId, setting.OSF_Website);
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"SyncPromotionFromOSFById Success - PromotionId: {promotionId}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"SyncPromotionFromOSFById Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"SyncPromotionFromOSFById Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }
    }

using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Repositories.SyncPromotion;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos;
using SyncData.Resources;

namespace SyncData.Areas.Sync.Controllers.OSF
{
    [Area(RouterResource.SYNC_AREA)]
    [Route(RouterResource.OSF_PROMOTION_AREA)]
    [ApiExplorerSettings(GroupName = "OSFPromotion")]
    public class OSFPromotionController : Controller
    {
        private readonly ISyncPromotionRepositories _syncPromotionRepositories;

        public OSFPromotionController(ISyncPromotionRepositories syncPromotionRepositories)
        {
            _syncPromotionRepositories = syncPromotionRepositories;
        }

        [HttpGet("")]
        public ErrorHandle SyncAllPromotionsFromOSF(int days = 30)
        {
            return _syncPromotionRepositories.GetAllPromotionFromOSF(days);
        }

        [HttpGet("{id}")]
        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncPromotionFromOSFById(string id)
        {
            return await _syncPromotionRepositories.SyncPromotionFromOSFById(id);
        }
    }
}

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncOutletFromOSFById(string outletId, string vendor)
        {
            try
            {
                var request = new GraphQLRequest
                {
                    Query = OSFResource.outletByIdQuery,
                    OperationName = "getOutlet",
                    Variables = new { id = outletId }
                };

                var outletResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(vendor, request);
                if (outletResult != null && outletResult.Data != null)
                {
                    OutletResponseModel outlet = outletResult.GetDataFieldAs<OutletResponseModel>("outlet");
                    if (outlet != null)
                    {
                        InsertOrUpdateOutlet(outlet, vendor);
                    }
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"SyncOutletFromOSFById Success - OutletId: {outletId}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"SyncOutletFromOSFById Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"SyncOutletFromOSFById Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }
    }
}

        public async Task<ErrorHandle> SyncRegisterFromOSFById(string registerId, string vendor)
        {
            try
            {
                var request = new GraphQLRequest
                {
                    Query = OSFResource.registerByIdQuery,
                    OperationName = "getRegister",
                    Variables = new { id = registerId }
                };

                var registerResult = await _client.CallApiGraphql(vendor, request);
                if (registerResult != null && registerResult.Data != null)
                {
                    RegisterResponseModel register = registerResult.GetDataFieldAs<RegisterResponseModel>("register");
                    if (register != null)
                    {
                        await InsertOrUpdateRegister(register, vendor);
                    }
                }

                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Success,
                    Message = $"SyncRegisterFromOSFById Success - RegisterId: {registerId}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _logger.LogError($"SyncRegisterFromOSFById Error: {e.Message}");
                return new ErrorHandle()
                {
                    ErrorCode = Const.ErrorHandleCode.Error,
                    Message = $"SyncRegisterFromOSFById Error: {e.Message}"
                };
            }
        }
    }
}

        public double? Savings { get; set; }

        [JsonProperty("quantity")]
        public double? Quantity { get; set; }

        }
    }
}
