using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Bepos.Models;
using MatthewsLiquor.Areas.OSF.Models;
using SyncData.Areas.Dtos.Bepos.Entities;
using static MatthewsLiquor.Resources.Const;

namespace MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Dtos.EF.Entities
{
    public class SaleOrder
    {
        public string SaleOrderId { get; set; }
        public string RegisterId { get; set; }
        public string RegisterName { get; set; }
        public string OutletId { get; set; }
        public string OutletName { get; set; }
        public string CustomerId { get; set; }
        public string CustomerName { get; set; }
        public string Status { get; set; }
        public string InvoiceId { get; set; }
        public double? TotalPrice { get; set; }
        public double? TotalBase { get; set; }
        public double? TotalSaving { get; set; }
        public double? TotalDiscount { get; set; }
        public double? TotalTax { get; set; }
        public double? TotalRounding { get; set; }
        public double? TotalChange { get; set; }
        public double? LoyaltyValue { get; set; }
        public double? Discount { get; set; }
        public string SubDomain { get; set; }
        public string OdooId { get; set; }
        public DateTime? OdooUpdate { get; set; }
        public DateTime? OnshopUpdate { get; set; }
        public DateTime? CreatedAt { get; set; }
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public string MagentoId { get; set; }
        public DateTime? MagentoUpdate { get; set; }
        public bool IsUpdateQtyMagento { get; set; }
        public string Note { get; set; }
        public string InternalNote { get; set; }
        public string OrderReference { get; set; }
        public string? ShippingAddress { get; set; }
        public double? Savings { get; set; }
        public string? CustomerPhone { get; set; }
        public string? EpointsId { get; set; }
        public string? UserId { get; set; }
        public string? RefId { get; set; }
        public string ClientId {get; set;}

        [NotMapped]
        public List<ItemSaleOrder> lstSaleOder { get; set; }

        public SaleOrder()
        {
        }

        public SaleOrder(SaleResponseModel saleResponse, string vendor)
        {
            this.SubDomain = vendor;
            this.SaleOrderId = saleResponse.Id;
            this.ClientId = saleResponse.ClientId;
            if(saleResponse.Register != null)
            {
                this.RegisterId = saleResponse.Register.Id;
                this.RegisterName = saleResponse.Register.Name;
                if(saleResponse.Register.Outlet != null)
                {
                    this.OutletId = saleResponse.Register.Outlet.Id;
                    this.OutletName = saleResponse.Register.Outlet.Name;
                }
            }
            if (saleResponse.Customer != null)
            {
                this.CustomerId = saleResponse.Customer.Id;
                this.CustomerName = saleResponse.Customer.Name;
                this.ShippingAddress = getShippingAddress(saleResponse.Customer.Delivery);
                if(saleResponse.Customer.Phone != null && saleResponse.Customer.Phone.Trim().Length > 0)
                {
                    this.CustomerPhone = saleResponse.Customer.Phone;
                }
                else
                {
                    this.CustomerPhone = saleResponse.Customer.Mobile;
                }
            }
            if(saleResponse.User != null)
            {
                this.UserId = saleResponse.User.Id;
            }
            this.Note = saleResponse.Note;
            this.InternalNote = saleResponse.InternalNote;
            this.OrderReference = saleResponse.OrderReference;
            this.Status = saleResponse.Status;
            this.InvoiceId = saleResponse.InvoiceId;
            this.TotalPrice = saleResponse.TotalPrice;
            this.TotalBase = saleResponse.TotalBase;
            this.TotalSaving = saleResponse.TotalSavings;
            this.TotalDiscount = saleResponse.TotalDiscount;
            this.TotalTax = saleResponse.TotalTax;
            this.TotalRounding = saleResponse.TotalRounding;
            this.TotalChange = saleResponse.TotalChange;
            this.Savings = saleResponse.TotalSavings;
            this.LoyaltyValue = saleResponse.loyaltyValue;
            if(saleResponse.Discount != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    this.Discount = double.Parse(saleResponse.Discount.Amount);
                }catch(Exception)
                {
                    this.Discount = 0;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                this.Discount = 0;
            }
            this.OnshopUpdate = saleResponse.UpdatedAt;
            this.CreatedAt = saleResponse.CreatedAt;
            if(saleResponse.LinkedSale != null){
                this.RefId = saleResponse.LinkedSale.Id;
            }
        }

        private string getShippingAddress(ContractResponseModel delivery)
        {
            string shippingAddress = "";
            if(delivery != null){
                if (delivery.AddressPostcode != null && delivery.AddressPostcode.Trim().Length > 0)
            {
                shippingAddress += $"{delivery.AddressPostcode}, ";
            }
            if (delivery.AddressStreet1 != null && delivery.AddressStreet1.Trim().Length > 0)
            {
                shippingAddress += $"{delivery.AddressStreet1}, ";
            }
            if (delivery.AddressStreet2 != null && delivery.AddressStreet2.Trim().Length > 0)
            {
                shippingAddress += $"{delivery.AddressStreet2}, ";
            }
            if (delivery.AddressSuburb != null && delivery.AddressSuburb.Trim().Length > 0)
            {
                shippingAddress += $"{delivery.AddressSuburb}, ";
            }
            if (delivery.AddressCity != null && delivery.AddressCity.Trim().Length > 0)
            {
                shippingAddress += $"{delivery.AddressCity}, ";
            }
            if (delivery.AddressRegion != null && delivery.AddressRegion.Trim().Length > 0)
            {
                shippingAddress += $"{delivery.AddressRegion}, ";
            }
            if (delivery.AddressCountry != null && delivery.AddressCountry.Trim().Length > 0)
            {
                shippingAddress += $"{delivery.AddressCountry}, ";
            }
            }

            return shippingAddress.Length > 0 ? shippingAddress.Substring(0, shippingAddress.Length - 2) : "";
        }

        public SaleOrder(BeposTransactionModel item)
        {
            this.SaleOrderId = item.TransactionID.ToString();
            this.TotalPrice = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.PaymentTotal);
            this.TotalBase = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.TransTotal);
            this.Discount = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(Math.Abs(item.DiscAmtAmt));
            this.TotalDiscount = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(Math.Abs(item.DiscAmtAmt));
            this.LoyaltyValue = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.PointsEarned);
            this.SubDomain = "bepos";
            this.OnshopUpdate = item.DateUpdated;
            this.CreatedAt = item.DateTimeTrans;
            this.OutletId = item.VenueID.ToString();
            this.OutletName = item.VenueName;
            this.CustomerId = item.AccountID.ToString();
            this.CustomerName = item.CustomerName;
            //this.LoyaltyValue = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.PointsEarned);
            //this.TotalSaving = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.PointsRedeemed));
            //this.Savings = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.PointsRedeemed));
            this.CustomerPhone = item.CustomerPhone;
            if (item.Processed == 2)
            {
                Status = SaleOrderStatus.COMPLETED;
                if (item.StoreID == BepozStore.WHOLESALE_STORE_ID)
                {
                    this.Status = SaleOrderStatus.PAID;
                }
                if (item.TransTotal < 0)
                {
                    this.Status = SaleOrderStatus.CANCELLED;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                this.Status = SaleOrderStatus.INCOMPLETE;
            }
            if(item.TransTotal > 0)
            {
                this.Note = item.Comment;
            }
            if(item.RefID != 0)
            {
                this.RefId = item.RefID.ToString();
            }
            this.UserId = item.OperatorID.ToString();
            this.RegisterId = item.TillID.ToString();
            this.RegisterName = item.WorkstationName;
        }

    }
}

namespace MatthewsLiquor.Areas.Dtos.EF.Entities
{
    public class ItemSaleOrder
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public double? Quantity { get; set; }
        public double? TotalPrice { get; set; }
        public string Item { get; set; }
        public string TypeNameItem { get; set; }
        public double? CaseQuantity { get; set; }
        public string SaleOrderId { get; set; }
        public double? BasePrice { get; set; }
        public double? Tax { get; set; }
        public double? TaxRate { get; set; }
        public double? Discount { get; set; }
        public double? DiscountMember { get; set; }
        public double? Savings { get; set; }
        public double? Cost { get; set; }

        public ItemSaleOrder()
        {
        }

        public ItemSaleOrder(SaleProductResponseModel item, string saleOrderId)
        {
            this.SaleOrderId = saleOrderId;
            this.Quantity = item.Quantity;
            this.TotalPrice = item.TotalPrice;
            this.Item = item.item.Id;
            this.TypeNameItem = item.item.TypeName;
            this.CaseQuantity = item.CaseQuantity;
            this.BasePrice = item.BasePrice;
            try{
                 this.Price = item.TotalPrice / item.Quantity;
            }catch(Exception){
                this.Price = 0;
            }
            this.Tax = item.Tax;
            this.Savings = item.Savings;
            if(item.TaxRate == null)
            {
                this.TaxRate = 10.0;
            }
            else
            {
                this.TaxRate = item.TaxRate.Amount;
            }
            if(item.Discount != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    this.Discount = double.Parse(item.Discount.Amount);
                }
                catch(Exception)
                {
                    this.Discount = 0;
                }
            }
            this.Cost = item.Cost;
        }

        public ItemSaleOrder(BeposTransactionProductModel item)
        {
            this.SaleOrderId = item.TransactionID.ToString();
            this.Size = item.Size;
            this.Quantity = item.UnitqtySold;
            this.Price = item.NettEach;
            if (item.Size == 1)
            {
                this.SizeQuantity = item.SizeQty_1;
            }

            if (item.Size == 2)
            {
                this.SizeQuantity = item.SizeQty_2;
            }

            if (item.Size == 3)
            {
                this.SizeQuantity = item.SizeQty_3;
            }

            if (item.Size == 4)
            {
                this.SizeQuantity = item.SizeQty_4;
            }

            if (item.Size == 5)
            {
                this.SizeQuantity = item.SizeQty_5;
            }

            if (item.Size == 6)
            {
                this.SizeQuantity = item.SizeQty_6;
            }

            if (item.Size == 7)
            {
                this.SizeQuantity = item.SizeQty_7;
            }

            if (item.Size == 8)
            {
                this.SizeQuantity = item.SizeQty_8;
            }
            if (item.Size == 9)
            {
                this.SizeQuantity = item.SizeQty_9;
            }

            if (item.Size == 10)
            {
                this.SizeQuantity = item.SizeQty_10;
            }

            this.TotalPrice = item.NettTotal;
            this.Item = item.ProductId.ToString();
            this.CaseQuantity = item.CaseQty;
            this.BasePrice = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.Gross);
            this.Tax = item.Tax_1;
            this.Cost = item.CostTotal;


            if(item.DiscNum_1 == BepozDiscountNumType.POINT_REDEEM)
            {
                DiscountMember = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.DiscAmt_1);
            }
            else if(item.DiscAmt_1 > 0)
            {
                this.Discount = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.DiscAmt_1);
            }

            if (item.DiscNum_2 == BepozDiscountNumType.POINT_REDEEM)
            {
                DiscountMember = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.DiscAmt_2);
            }
            else if (item.DiscAmt_2 > 0)
            {
                this.Discount = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.DiscAmt_2);
            }

            if (item.DiscNum_3 == BepozDiscountNumType.POINT_REDEEM)
            {
                DiscountMember = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.DiscAmt_3);
            }
            else if (item.DiscAmt_3 > 0)
            {
                this.Discount = Helper.FormatBeposPrice(item.DiscAmt_3);
            }
            this.PromotionId = item.DiscPromoID_1.ToString();
        }
    }
}
